290: fn build_target_url(endpoint: &str, path: &str, query: Option<&str>) -> Result<String, QueueError> {
291:     let endpoint = if endpoint.ends_with('/') {
292:         endpoint.to_string()
293:     } else {
294:         format!("{endpoint}/")
295:     };
296: 
297:     let base_url = Url::parse(&endpoint)
298:         .map_err(|error| QueueError::Other(format!("invalid endpoint {endpoint}: {error}")))?;
299:     let relative_path = if base_url
300:         .path()
301:         .trim_end_matches('/')
302:         .ends_with(crate::services::common::BASE_PATH)
303:     {
304:         path.strip_prefix(crate::services::common::BASE_PATH)
305:             .unwrap_or(path)
306:             .trim_start_matches('/')
307:     } else {
308:         path.trim_start_matches('/')
309:     };
310: 
311:     let mut url = base_url
312:         .join(relative_path)
313:         .map_err(|error| QueueError::Other(format!("invalid path {path}: {error}")))?;
314: 
315:     if let Some(query_string) = query {
316:         url.set_query(Some(query_string));
317:     }
318: 
319:     Ok(url.to_string())
320: }

<type>file</type>
<content>
1: # Cognets Broker
2: 
3: `cognets_broker` is a modular NGSI-LD Context Broker written in Rust with `actix-web`.
4: 
5: Current runtime pieces:
6: 
7: - `actix-web` for the HTTP API
8: - MongoDB for persisted entities, temporal entities, subscriptions, registrations, and peers
9: - Redis Streams for queued federation and notification delivery
10: - registration-based federation plus SWIM-style P2P swarm synchronization over Redis Streams
11: 
12: The codebase is being aligned to the ETSI NGSI-LD API surface:
13: 
14: - https://cim.etsi.org/NGSI-LD/official/front-page.html
15: - https://forge.etsi.org/rep/cim/ngsi-ld-openapi/-/raw/v1.8.1/openapi-3.0.3/ngsi-ld-api.yaml
16: 
17: This repository is no longer the original in-memory skeleton. It now uses MongoDB-backed repositories and a split module layout, but it is still not fully ETSI-complete. See `IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.md` for the current implemented vs missing list.
18: 
19: ## Modules
20: 
21: - `src/api.rs`: Actix route wiring
22: - `src/app`: shared application state
23: - `src/context`: tenant, `Via`, and `Link` header handling
24: - `src/domain`: persisted document and result types
25: - `src/federation`: queue and P2P message models
26: - `src/persistence`: repository traits and MongoDB implementations
27: - `src/query`: entity and temporal query DTOs plus Mongo query planning
28: - `src/services`: entity, temporal, registration, subscription, notification, and federation logic
29: - `src/utils`: JSON and time helpers
30: 
31: ## How It Works
32: 
33: At runtime the broker handles each request in four layers:
34: 
35: 1. `src/api.rs` maps HTTP routes under `/ngsi-ld/v1` to service functions and normalizes request metadata.
36: 2. `src/context/headers.rs` extracts `NGSILD-Tenant`, `Link`, and `Via`. `Link` can backfill `@context`; `Via` is preserved for loop avoidance in federation and P2P.
37: 3. `src/services/*` performs validation, applies NGSI-LD semantics, persists state locally, and triggers side effects.
38: 4. `src/persistence/mongo.rs` stores wrappers such as `{ tenant, id, doc }` in MongoDB. Redis Streams are used for queued outbound federation, notifications, and SWIM membership/mutation dissemination.
39: 
40: Write flow:
41: 
42: - persist entity/temporal/subscription/registration locally in MongoDB
43: - enqueue notifications and registration-based federation when applicable
44: - record swarm mutation snapshots for entity and temporal writes when P2P is enabled
45: 
46: Read flow:
47: 
48: - query local MongoDB first using filters built in `src/query/planner.rs`
49: - if `local!=true`, fan out to matching context source registrations and merge remote results
50: - apply output projection (`normalized`, `keyValues`, `GeoJSON`, temporal formats) before returning the response
51: 
52: Current decentralized sync model:
53: 
54: - local writes create durable mutation records in MongoDB
55: - SWIM membership events and mutation dissemination run through Redis Streams
56: - background SWIM worker updates peer liveness and applies remote mutation snapshots
57:

107: ## Query Support
108: 
109: Implemented entity query features:
110: 
111: - `id`, `type`, `idPattern`, `attrs`, `pick`, `omit`, `limit`, `count`, `local`
112: - `q` expressions with `==`, `!=`, `>`, `>=`, `<`, `<=`
113: - simple range expressions in the form `attr..lower,upper`
114: - top-level `;` and `|` composition for AND and OR
115: - normalized JSON, `keyValues`, and GeoJSON response projections
116: 
117: Implemented discovery features:
118: 
119: - `/types` returns `EntityTypeList` or detailed `EntityTypeInfo[]` with `details=true`
120: - `/types/{type}` returns `EntityTypeInfo`
121: - `/attributes` returns `AttributeList` or detailed `Attribute[]` with `details=true`
122: - `/attributes/{attrId}` returns `Attribute`
123: 
124: Implemented geo query features:
125: 
126: - `geometry`, `georel`, `coordinates`, `geoproperty`
127: - geometries: `Point`, `MultiPoint`, `LineString`, `MultiLineString`, `Polygon`, `MultiPolygon`
128: - `georel`: `within`, `intersects`, `contains`, `overlaps`, `equals`, and `near` with `minDistance` and `maxDistance`
129: 
130: Implemented temporal query features:
131: 
132: - `timerel=before|after|between`
133: - `timeAt`, `endTimeAt`, `timeproperty`, `lastN`
134: - `format=temporalValues|aggregatedValues`
135: - basic aggregation over numeric values for `sum`, `avg`, `min`, `max`, `totalCount`, and `distinctCount`
136: 
137: ## Federation And Delivery
138: 
139: Implemented federation pieces:
140: 
141: - Context Source Registration matching for query and write forwarding
142: - Context Source Registration Subscription CRUD plus queued `CsourceNotification` delivery on matching registration create, update, and delete
143: - Redis-backed worker for outbound federation and notification delivery
144: - `Via` and alias-based loop avoidance for registration federation
145: - peer persistence in MongoDB
146: - SWIM-style membership with `alive`, `suspect`, and `dead` peer states
147: - durable swarm mutation log stored in MongoDB
148: - Redis Stream dissemination of peer membership and mutation events
149: - duplicate suppression by `mutationId`
150: - local mutation recording for entity and temporal write paths as full-state snapshots
151: 
152: Recent stabilizations included:
153: 
154: - fixing outbound federation URL construction so `/ngsi-ld/v1` is not duplicated when the target endpoint already includes the base path
155: 
156: ## Swarm Model
157: 
158: Current P2P model is SWIM-only.
159: 
160: Each broker:
161: 
162: - persists peer membership state in MongoDB
163: - publishes SWIM `alive`, `suspect`, and `dead` events through Redis Streams
164: - records local mutations into durable MongoDB mutation log
165: - publishes mutation snapshots through Redis Streams
166: - applies unseen remote mutations only when incoming version is newer
167: 
168: This keeps convergence state-based. Peers synchronize resource snapshots and membership state, not public write requests or ad-hoc HTTP gossip.
169: 
170: ## Configuration
171: 
172: Environment variables:
173: 
174: - `BROKER_HOST`: bind host, default `127.0.0.1`
175: - `BROKER_PORT`: bind port, default `8080`
176: - `BROKER_ID`: broker identifier, default `cognets-broker`
177: - `BROKER_PUBLIC_ENDPOINT`: public broker base URL, default `http://127.0.0.1:8080/ngsi-ld/v1`
178: - `BROKER_MONGO_URL`: MongoDB connection string, default `mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017`
179: - `BROKER_MONGO_DATABASE`: MongoDB database name, default `cognets_broker`
180: - `BROKER_REDIS_URL`: Redis connection string, default `redis://127.0.0.1/`
181: - `BROKER_REDIS_STREAM`: Redis Stream name, default `ngsild:federation`
182: - `BROKER_REDIS_CONSUMER_GROUP`: Redis consumer group, default `ngsild-brokers`
183: - `BROKER_REDIS_CONSUMER_NAME`: Redis consumer name, default value of `BROKER_ID`
184: - `BROKER_OUTBOUND_TIMEOUT_MS`: outbound HTTP timeout in milliseconds, default `5000`
185: - `BROKER_P2P_ENABLED`: enable P2P logic, default `true`
186: - `BROKER_P2P_SYNC_INTERVAL_MS`: SWIM probe and maintenance interval in milliseconds, default `10000`
187: - `BROKER_P2P_SWIM_SUSPECT_TIMEOUT_MS`: timeout before alive peers degrade to suspect, default `15000`
188: - `BROKER_P2P_SEEDS`: comma-separated peer endpoints, default empty
189: 
190: For P2P peers, the recommended value format is a broker base URL such as `http://127.0.0.1:8081/ngsi-ld/v1`.
191: 
192: ## Run
193: 
194: Start MongoDB and Redis first, then run:
195: 
196: ```bash
197: cargo run
198: ```

211: ```
212:

215: Run:

218: cargo test
219: ```

223: - query planner parsing and BSON generation

227: - notification matching rules
228: - handler-level validation responses for bad requests
229:

231: 
232: ## Current Gaps
233: 
234: Major gaps are tracked in `IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.md`.
235: 
236: Important current limits:
237: 
238: - several NGSI-LD query parameters are parsed but not yet implemented end-to-end
239: - registration query filtering is only partial
240: - csource subscription matching now applies entity selectors, `watchedAttributes`, `q`, `csf`, `geoQ`, `scopeQ`, `temporalQ`, and lifecycle-oriented `notificationTrigger` filtering; full ETSI scope-query and context-source-filter semantics are still partial
241: - JSON-LD context cache APIs are not implemented
242: - the swarm model still relies on wall-clock ordering via `modifiedAt`; there is no vector-clock or CRDT conflict model yet
243: - mutation-log retention, pruning, and compaction policies are not implemented yet
244: - peer authentication, authorization, and trust scoring are not implemented for SWIM stream producers or consumers
245: - notification retry scheduling, backoff, and dead-letter handling are not implemented

39: ## Current P2P Model
40: 
41: Current implementation uses only SWIM-style membership plus Redis Stream dissemination.
42: 
43: Current model combines:
44: 
45: - periodic SWIM liveness rounds
46: - membership state transitions between `alive`, `suspect`, and `dead`
47: - Redis Stream dissemination for membership and mutation events
48: - durable local mutation persistence instead of transient in-memory gossip
49: - deduplication by mutation id
50: - version checks before applying remote state
51: - state snapshots instead of replaying public write requests with non-deterministic side effects
52: 
53: For current codebase, this gives one swarm transport and one membership model. Old internal HTTP peer announcement and mutation gossip paths are removed.

55: ## Partial Or Missing
56: 
57: - Live end-to-end tests against real MongoDB and Redis services are not part of the current automated suite.
58: - The implementation is not ETSI NGSI-LD complete.

65: - `joinLevel`
66: - `datasetId`
67: - `entityMap`

69: - `lang`
70: - `pick` and `omit` are implemented only as response projection, not as database-side filtering.
71: - Registration list filtering is currently limited to `id`, `type`, `limit`, and `count`; the other registration query fields are accepted by the DTO but not applied.
72: - Csource subscription matching now applies `entities`, `watchedAttributes`, `q`, `geoQ`, `csf`, `scopeQ`, `temporalQ`, and lifecycle-oriented `notificationTrigger` filtering, but full ETSI scope-query and context-source-filter semantics remain partial.
73: - Geo query support does not implement `georel=disjoint`; that path returns `501 Not Implemented`.
74: - Temporal query execution still loads matching temporal documents first and then filters history in service code; there is no dedicated MongoDB temporal aggregation pipeline yet.

79: - SWIM worker still discovers tenants by probing Mongo collections; there is no dedicated tenant registry yet.
80: - Notification delivery has basic enqueue and status accounting, but no retry scheduler, no backoff policy, and no dead-letter handling.

<content>
1: # AGENTS.md
2: 
3: ## Response Style
4: - User-facing replies stay terse "smart caveman". Switch to normal wording for security warnings, irreversible actions, and code/commit/PR text.
5: 
6: ## Verify
7: - No repo CI/workflow files. Pre-handoff check: `cargo fmt --check && cargo test`.
8: 
9: ## Run
10: - `cargo run` expects MongoDB and Redis already up. Startup connects to Mongo, creates indexes, and starts Redis Stream worker immediately.
11: - Config comes from `std::env`. `.env.example` is reference only; `.env` is gitignored but not auto-loaded.
12: - Use broker base URLs ending in `/ngsi-ld/v1` for `BROKER_PUBLIC_ENDPOINT`, registration endpoints, and `BROKER_P2P_SEEDS`. Service code often appends resource paths directly.
13: 
14: ## Architecture
15: - `src/api.rs` only wires Actix routes. Real behavior lives in `src/services/*`; Mongo filter building lives in `src/query/planner.rs`; tenant/`Link`/`Via` handling lives in `src/context/headers.rs`.
16: - Persisted entities are wrappers, not raw NGSI-LD payloads: entities use `{ tenant, id, doc }`; temporals use `{ tenant, id, doc, history }`. Mongo filters/indexes use top-level `id` plus nested `doc.*` fields.
17: - Every repository key/index includes `tenant`. `NGSILD-Tenant` defaults to `default`; forgetting tenant filters causes cross-tenant bugs.
18: - `Link` header backfills `@context` only when payload lacks it. `Via` header is federation/P2P loop-avoidance state; preserve and extend it when changing forwarding code.
19: - `services::entities::{query,get}` read local Mongo first, then fan out to matching registrations unless `local=true`. Write paths persist locally first, then enqueue notifications/federation/swarm side effects.
20: - Geo queries can target arbitrary `geoproperty`, but startup creates 2dsphere index only for `doc.location.value`.
21: 
22: ## P2P And Delivery Quirks
23: - Runtime launches `services::federation::start_swarm_sync_worker` at startup.
24: - Current P2P model is SWIM-only over Redis Streams; old internal HTTP peer announcement and mutation gossip endpoints are gone.
25: - `RedisEventQueue` ACKs stream messages after each processing attempt, even failures. Current outbound federation/notification delivery is best-effort; no retry/dead-letter flow.
26: 
27: ## Tests
28: - API tests mirror `api::tests::test_state()`: `AppConfig::for_tests()`, `p2p_enabled = false`, `InMemoryEventQueue`, `MongoRepositories::new_without_indexes()`.
29: - `cargo test` still needs MongoDB on `127.0.0.1:27017` for API/swarm-mutation tests. Redis is not required by current test suite.

(End of file - total 29 lines)

284: pub fn ensure_attribute_exists(entity: &Value, attr_id: &str) -> Result<(), BrokerError> {

287:             "attribute {attr_id} was not found"
288:         )));

293: pub fn entity_type_matches(value: Option<&Value>, expected: &str) -> bool {
294:     match value {
295:         Some(Value::String(actual)) => actual == expected,
296:         Some(Value::Array(items)) => items.iter().any(|item| item.as_str() == Some(expected)),
297:         _ => false,
298:     }
299: }

301: pub fn entity_primary_type(entity: &Value) -> Option<String> {
302:     match entity.get("type") {
303:         Some(Value::String(value)) => Some(value.clone()),
304:         Some(Value::Array(items)) => items
305:             .first()
306:             .and_then(Value::as_str)
307:             .map(ToString::to_string),
308:         _ => None,
309:     }
310: }

312: pub fn project_entity(
313:     entity: &Value,
314:     attrs: Option<&str>,
315:     pick: Option<&str>,
316:     omit: Option<&str>,
317:     representation: Representation,
318: ) -> Value {
319:     let mut projected = entity.clone();
320:     if let Some(object) = projected.as_object_mut() {
321:         let selected = if let Some(pick) = pick {
322:             parse_csv(Some(pick))
323:         } else if let Some(attrs) = attrs {
324:             parse_csv(Some(attrs))
325:         } else {
326:             Vec::new()
327:         };
328: 
329:         if !selected.is_empty() {
330:             object.retain(|key, _| reserved_member(key) || selected.iter().any(|item| item == key));
331:         }
332: 
333:         for omitted in parse_csv(omit) {
334:             object.remove(&omitted);
335:         }
336:     }
337: 
338:     match representation {
339:         Representation::Normalized => projected,
340:         Representation::KeyValues => simplify_entity(&projected),
341:         Representation::GeoJson => entity_to_feature(&projected),
342:         Representation::TemporalValues | Representation::AggregatedValues => projected,
343:     }
344: }
345: 
346: pub fn simplify_entity(entity: &Value) -> Value {
347:     let mut simplified = Map::new();
348: 
349:     if let Some(object) = entity.as_object() {
350:         for (key, value) in object {
351:             if reserved_member(key) {
352:                 simplified.insert(key.clone(), value.clone());
353:             } else {
354:                 simplified.insert(key.clone(), simplify_attribute_value(value));
355:             }
356:         }
357:     }
358: 
359:     Value::Object(simplified)
360: }
361: 
362: pub fn simplify_attribute_value(value: &Value) -> Value {
363:     match value {
364:         Value::Object(object) => match object.get("type").and_then(Value::as_str) {
365:             Some("Property") | Some("GeoProperty") => {
366:                 object.get("value").cloned().unwrap_or(Value::Null)
367:             }
368:             Some("Relationship") | Some("ListRelationship") => {
369:                 object.get("object").cloned().unwrap_or(Value::Null)
370:             }
371:             Some("LanguageProperty") => object.get("languageMap").cloned().unwrap_or(Value::Null),
372:             Some("VocabProperty") => object.get("vocab").cloned().unwrap_or(Value::Null),
373:             _ => Value::Object(
374:                 object
375:                     .iter()
376:                     .map(|(key, inner)| (key.clone(), simplify_attribute_value(inner)))
377:                     .collect(),
378:             ),
379:         },
380:         Value::Array(items) => Value::Array(items.iter().map(simplify_attribute_value).collect()),
381:         _ => value.clone(),
382:     }
383: }
384: 
385: pub fn entity_to_feature(entity: &Value) -> Value {
386:     let simplified = simplify_entity(entity);
387:     let mut properties = simplified.as_object().cloned().unwrap_or_default();
388:     let id = properties
389:         .remove("id")
390:         .and_then(|value| value.as_str().map(ToString::to_string))
391:         .unwrap_or_default();
392:     properties.remove("@context");
393:     let geometry = properties.remove("location").unwrap_or(Value::Null);
394: 
395:     let mut feature = Map::new();
396:     feature.insert("id".to_string(), Value::String(id));
397:     feature.insert("type".to_string(), Value::String("Feature".to_string()));
398:     feature.insert("geometry".to_string(), geometry);
399:     feature.insert("properties".to_string(), Value::Object(properties));
400:     if let Some(context) = entity.get("@context") {
401:         feature.insert("@context".to_string(), context.clone());
402:     }
403:     Value::Object(feature)
404: }

406: pub fn temporal_entity_to_response(
407:     entity: &Value,
408:     history: &[Value],
409:     query: &TemporalEntityQuery,
410:     representation: Representation,
411: ) -> Value {
412:     let mut temporal = project_entity(
413:         entity,
414:         query.entity.attrs.as_deref(),
415:         query.entity.pick.as_deref(),
416:         query.entity.omit.as_deref(),
417:         Representation::Normalized,
418:     );
419: 
420:     if let Some(object) = temporal.as_object_mut() {
421:         let grouped = history.iter().fold(Map::new(), |mut acc, item| {
422:             if let Some(attr_id) = item.get("attrId").and_then(Value::as_str) {
423:                 acc.entry(attr_id.to_string())
424:                     .or_insert_with(|| Value::Array(Vec::new()));
425:                 if let Some(list) = acc.get_mut(attr_id).and_then(Value::as_array_mut) {
426:                     list.push(item.clone());
427:                 }
428:             }
429:             acc
430:         });
431: 
432:         for (key, value) in grouped {
433:             object.insert(key, value);
434:         }
435:     }
436: 
437:     match representation {
438:         Representation::TemporalValues
439:         | Representation::AggregatedValues
440:         | Representation::Normalized => temporal,
441:         Representation::KeyValues => simplify_entity(&temporal),
442:         Representation::GeoJson => entity_to_feature(&temporal),
443:     }
444: }

454: pub fn entity_matches_query_with_options(
455:     entity: &Value,
456:     query: &EntityQuery,
457:     options: &QueryMatchOptions,
458: ) -> bool {
459:     if let Some(ids) = &query.id {
460:         let entity_id = entity.get("id").and_then(Value::as_str).unwrap_or_default();
461:         if !ids
462:             .split(',')
463:             .any(|candidate| candidate.trim() == entity_id)
464:         {
465:             return false;
466:         }
467:     }
468: 
469:     if let Some(entity_type) = &query.entity_type {
470:         let types = parse_csv(Some(entity_type));
471:         if !types
472:             .iter()
473:             .any(|candidate| entity_type_matches(entity.get("type"), candidate))
474:         {
475:             return false;
476:         }
477:     }
478: 
479:     if let Some(id_pattern) = &query.id_pattern {
480:         let entity_id = entity.get("id").and_then(Value::as_str).unwrap_or_default();
481:         match Regex::new(id_pattern) {
482:             Ok(regex) if regex.is_match(entity_id) => {}
483:             Ok(_) | Err(_) => return false,
484:         }
485:     }
486: 
487:     let attrs = parse_csv(query.attrs.as_deref());
488:     if !attrs.is_empty() && !attrs.iter().all(|attr| entity.get(attr).is_some()) {
489:         return false;
490:     }
491: 
492:     if !query_matches_value_with_options(entity, query.q.as_deref(), options).unwrap_or(false) {
493:         return false;
494:     }
495: 
496:     scope_query_matches_values(&extract_scope_values(entity), query.scope_q.as_deref())
497:         .unwrap_or(false)
498: }

320:     context: &RequestContext,
321:     entity_id: &str,
322:     requested_type: Option<&str>,
323:     mut entity: Value,
324:     local_only: bool,
325:     _query_string: Option<String>,
326: ) -> Result<(), BrokerError> {
327:     let existing = state
328:         .repositories
329:         .entities
330:         .get(&context.tenant, entity_id)
331:         .await?
332:         .ok_or_else(|| BrokerError::NotFound(format!("entity {entity_id} was not found")))?;
333:     ensure_requested_type(&existing.doc, requested_type)?;
334:     prepare_entity_for_replace(
335:         &mut entity,
336:         entity_id,
337:         context,
338:         existing.doc.get("createdAt"),
339:     )?;
340: 
341:     state
342:         .repositories
343:         .entities
344:         .replace(StoredDocument {
345:             tenant: context.tenant.clone(),
346:             ngsi_id: entity_id.to_string(),
347:             doc: entity.clone(),
348:         })
349:         .await?;
350: 
351:     notifications::enqueue_notifications(
352:         state,
353:         &context.tenant,
354:         &entity,
355:         &EntityEvent {
356:             kind: EntityEventKind::Updated,
357:             changed_attributes: changed_attribute_names(&entity),
358:         },
359:     )
360:     .await?;
361: 
362:     if !local_only {
363:         federation::record_local_swarm_mutation(
364:             state,
365:             federation::SwarmMutationInput {
366:                 tenant: context.tenant.clone(),
367:                 resource_kind: SwarmResourceKind::Entity,
368:                 operation: SwarmOperation::Upsert,
369:                 entity_id: entity_id.to_string(),
370:                 version_at: entity
371:                     .get("modifiedAt")
372:                     .and_then(Value::as_str)
373:                     .unwrap_or_default()
374:                     .to_string(),
375:                 source_peer_id: state.config.broker_id.clone(),
376:                 event_kind: SwarmEventKind::Updated,
377:                 changed_attributes: changed_attribute_names(&entity),
378:                 snapshot: Some(entity.clone()),
379:             },
380:         )
381:         .await?;
382:     }
383: 
384:     Ok(())
385: }

387: pub async fn append_attrs(
388:     state: &AppState,
389:     context: &RequestContext,
390:     entity_id: &str,
391:     requested_type: Option<&str>,
392:     fragment: Value,
393:     no_overwrite: bool,
394:     local_only: bool,
395:     _query_string: Option<String>,
396: ) -> Result<UpdateResult, BrokerError> {
397:     ensure_fragment_id_matches(&fragment, entity_id)?;
398:     let mut existing = state
399:         .repositories
400:         .entities
401:         .get(&context.tenant, entity_id)
402:         .await?
403:         .ok_or_else(|| BrokerError::NotFound(format!("entity {entity_id} was not found")))?;
404:     ensure_requested_type(&existing.doc, requested_type)?;
405: 
406:     let attrs = editable_fragment_members(&fragment);
407:     let mut result = UpdateResult::default();
408:     if let Some(object) = existing.doc.as_object_mut() {
409:         for (key, value) in attrs {
410:             if no_overwrite && object.contains_key(&key) {
411:                 result.not_updated.push(not_updated(
412:                     &key,
413:                     409,
414:                     format!("attribute {key} already exists"),
415:                 ));
416:             } else {
417:                 object.insert(key.clone(), value);
418:                 result.updated.push(key);
419:             }
420:         }
421:         object.insert("modifiedAt".to_string(), Value::String(now_timestamp()));
422:     }
423: 
424:     state
425:         .repositories
426:         .entities
427:         .replace(existing.clone())
428:         .await?;
429:     if !result.updated.is_empty() {
430:         notifications::enqueue_notifications(
431:             state,
432:             &context.tenant,
433:             &existing.doc,
434:             &EntityEvent {
435:                 kind: EntityEventKind::Updated,
436:                 changed_attributes: result.updated.clone(),
437:             },
438:         )
439:         .await?;
440:     }
441:     if !local_only && !result.updated.is_empty() {
442:         federation::record_local_swarm_mutation(
443:             state,
444:             federation::SwarmMutationInput {
445:                 tenant: context.tenant.clone(),
446:                 resource_kind: SwarmResourceKind::Entity,
447:                 operation: SwarmOperation::Upsert,
448:                 entity_id: entity_id.to_string(),
449:                 version_at: existing
450:                     .doc
451:                     .get("modifiedAt")
452:                     .and_then(Value::as_str)
453:                     .unwrap_or_default()
454:                     .to_string(),
455:                 source_peer_id: state.config.broker_id.clone(),
456:                 event_kind: SwarmEventKind::Updated,
457:                 changed_attributes: result.updated.clone(),
458:                 snapshot: Some(existing.doc.clone()),
459:             },
460:         )
461:         .await?;
462:     }
463: 
464:     Ok(result)
465: }

584:         },
585:     )
586:     .await?;
587: 
588:     if !local_only {
589:         federation::record_local_swarm_mutation(

605:                 snapshot: Some(existing.doc.clone()),
606:             },
607:         )
608:         .await?;
609:     }
610:     Ok(())

744: pub async fn batch_create(
745:     state: &AppState,
746:     context: &RequestContext,
747:     entities: Vec<Value>,
748:     local_only: bool,
749:     _query_string: Option<String>,
750: ) -> Result<Result<Vec<String>, BatchOperationResult>, BrokerError> {
751:     let mut created = Vec::new();
752:     let mut result = BatchOperationResult::default();
753:     let mut docs = Vec::new();
754: 
755:     for mut entity in entities {
756:         match prepare_entity_for_create(&mut entity, context) {
757:             Ok(entity_id) => {
758:                 if state
759:                     .repositories
760:                     .entities
761:                     .get(&context.tenant, &entity_id)
762:                     .await?
763:                     .is_some()
764:                 {
765:                     result.errors.push(batch_error(
766:                         &entity_id,
767:                         409,
768:                         format!("entity {entity_id} already exists"),
769:                     ));
770:                 } else {
771:                     created.push(entity_id.clone());
772:                     result.success.push(entity_id.clone());
773:                     docs.push(entity.clone());
774:                     state
775:                         .repositories
776:                         .entities
777:                         .insert(StoredDocument {
778:                             tenant: context.tenant.clone(),
779:                             ngsi_id: entity_id,
780:                             doc: entity,
781:                         })
782:                         .await?;
783:                 }
784:             }
785:             Err(error) => result.errors.push(batch_error(
786:                 "unknown",
787:                 error.status_code().as_u16(),
788:                 error.to_string(),
789:             )),
790:         }
791:     }
792: 
793:     for entity in &docs {
794:         notifications::enqueue_notifications(
795:             state,
796:             &context.tenant,
797:             entity,
798:             &EntityEvent {
799:                 kind: EntityEventKind::Created,
800:                 changed_attributes: changed_attribute_names(entity),
801:             },
802:         )
803:         .await?;
804:     }
805: 
806:     if !local_only && !docs.is_empty() {
807:         for entity in &docs {
808:             let entity_id = entity
809:                 .get("id")
810:                 .and_then(Value::as_str)
811:                 .unwrap_or_default()
812:                 .to_string();
813:             federation::record_local_swarm_mutation(
814:                 state,
815:                 federation::SwarmMutationInput {
816:                     tenant: context.tenant.clone(),
817:                     resource_kind: SwarmResourceKind::Entity,
818:                     operation: SwarmOperation::Upsert,
819:                     entity_id,
820:                     version_at: entity
821:                         .get("modifiedAt")
822:                         .and_then(Value::as_str)
823:                         .unwrap_or_default()
824:                         .to_string(),
825:                     source_peer_id: state.config.broker_id.clone(),
826:                     event_kind: SwarmEventKind::Created,
827:                     changed_attributes: changed_attribute_names(entity),
828:                     snapshot: Some(entity.clone()),
829:                 },
830:             )
831:             .await?;
832:         }
833:     }
834: 
835:     if result.errors.is_empty() {
836:         Ok(Ok(created))
837:     } else {
838:         Ok(Err(result))
839:     }
840: }

842: pub async fn batch_upsert(
843:     state: &AppState,
844:     context: &RequestContext,
845:     entities: Vec<Value>,
846:     update_mode: bool,
847:     local_only: bool,
848:     _query_string: Option<String>,
849: ) -> Result<Result<crate::domain::batch::BatchUpsertOutcome, BatchOperationResult>, BrokerError> {
850:     let mut created_ids = Vec::new();
851:     let mut had_updates = false;
852:     let mut result = BatchOperationResult::default();
853:     let mut docs = Vec::new();
854: 
855:     for mut entity in entities {
856:         match prepare_entity_for_create(&mut entity, context) {
857:             Ok(entity_id) => {
858:                 let existing = state
859:                     .repositories
860:                     .entities
861:                     .get(&context.tenant, &entity_id)
862:                     .await?;
863:                 if let Some(mut existing) = existing {
864:                     had_updates = true;
865:                     if update_mode {
866:                         apply_merge_patch(&mut existing.doc, &entity);
867:                     } else {
868:                         prepare_entity_for_replace(
869:                             &mut entity,
870:                             &entity_id,
871:                             context,
872:                             existing.doc.get("createdAt"),
873:                         )?;
874:                         existing.doc = entity.clone();
875:                     }
876:                     state
877:                         .repositories
878:                         .entities
879:                         .replace(existing.clone())
880:                         .await?;
881:                     docs.push(existing.doc.clone());
882:                     result.success.push(entity_id);
883:                 } else {
884:                     created_ids.push(entity_id.clone());
885:                     result.success.push(entity_id.clone());
886:                     docs.push(entity.clone());
887:                     state
888:                         .repositories
889:                         .entities
890:                         .insert(StoredDocument {
891:                             tenant: context.tenant.clone(),
892:                             ngsi_id: entity_id,
893:                             doc: entity,
894:                         })
895:                         .await?;
896:                 }
897:             }
898:             Err(error) => result.errors.push(batch_error(
899:                 "unknown",
900:                 error.status_code().as_u16(),
901:                 error.to_string(),
902:             )),
903:         }
904:     }
905: 
906:     if !local_only && !docs.is_empty() {
907:         for entity in &docs {
908:             let entity_id = entity
909:                 .get("id")
910:                 .and_then(Value::as_str)
911:                 .unwrap_or_default()
912:                 .to_string();
913:             federation::record_local_swarm_mutation(
914:                 state,
915:                 federation::SwarmMutationInput {
916:                     tenant: context.tenant.clone(),
917:                     resource_kind: SwarmResourceKind::Entity,
918:                     operation: SwarmOperation::Upsert,
919:                     entity_id,
920:                     version_at: entity
921:                         .get("modifiedAt")
922:                         .and_then(Value::as_str)
923:                         .unwrap_or_default()
924:                         .to_string(),
925:                     source_peer_id: state.config.broker_id.clone(),
926:                     event_kind: SwarmEventKind::Updated,
927:                     changed_attributes: changed_attribute_names(entity),
928:                     snapshot: Some(entity.clone()),
929:                 },
930:             )
931:             .await?;
932:         }
933:     }
934: 
935:     if result.errors.is_empty() {
936:         Ok(Ok(crate::domain::batch::BatchUpsertOutcome {
937:             created_ids,
938:             had_updates,
939:         }))
940:     } else {
941:         Ok(Err(result))
942:     }
943: }

945: pub async fn batch_update(
946:     state: &AppState,
947:     context: &RequestContext,
948:     entities: Vec<Value>,
949:     no_overwrite: bool,
950:     local_only: bool,
951:     _query_string: Option<String>,
952: ) -> Result<Result<(), BatchOperationResult>, BrokerError> {
953:     let mut result = BatchOperationResult::default();
954:     let mut docs = Vec::new();
955: 
956:     for entity in entities {
957:         let Some(entity_id) = entity.get("id").and_then(Value::as_str) else {
958:             result.errors.push(batch_error(
959:                 "unknown",
960:                 400,
961:                 "payload entity must include an id",
962:             ));
963:             continue;
964:         };
965: 
966:         match state
967:             .repositories
968:             .entities
969:             .get(&context.tenant, entity_id)
970:             .await?
971:         {
972:             Some(mut existing) => {
973:                 let attrs = editable_fragment_members(&entity);
974:                 if let Some(object) = existing.doc.as_object_mut() {
975:                     for (key, value) in attrs {
976:                         if no_overwrite && object.contains_key(&key) {
977:                             continue;
978:                         }
979:                         object.insert(key, value);
980:                     }
981:                     object.insert("modifiedAt".to_string(), Value::String(now_timestamp()));
982:                 }
983:                 state
984:                     .repositories
985:                     .entities
986:                     .replace(existing.clone())
987:                     .await?;
988:                 docs.push(existing.doc.clone());
989:                 result.success.push(entity_id.to_string());
990:             }
991:             None => result.errors.push(batch_error(
992:                 entity_id,
993:                 404,
994:                 format!("entity {entity_id} was not found"),
995:             )),
996:         }
997:     }
998: 
999:     if !local_only && !docs.is_empty() {
1000:         for entity in &docs {
1001:             let entity_id = entity
1002:                 .get("id")
1003:                 .and_then(Value::as_str)
1004:                 .unwrap_or_default()
1005:                 .to_string();
1006:             federation::record_local_swarm_mutation(
1007:                 state,
1008:                 federation::SwarmMutationInput {
1009:                     tenant: context.tenant.clone(),
1010:                     resource_kind: SwarmResourceKind::Entity,
1011:                     operation: SwarmOperation::Upsert,

1035: pub async fn batch_delete(

1086: fn dedupe(items: Vec<Value>) -> Vec<Value> {
1087:     let mut seen = std::collections::HashSet::new();
1088:     let mut deduped = Vec::new();
1089:     for item in items {
1090:         let id = item

1092:             .and_then(Value::as_str)
1093:             .unwrap_or_default()
1094:             .to_string();
1095:         if seen.insert(id) {
1096:             deduped.push(item);
1097:         }
1098:     }
1099:     deduped

91: ) -> Result<TemporalQueryResult, BrokerError> {
92:     let plan = MongoQueryPlan::from_entity_query(&query.entity)?;
93:     let temporal = TemporalFilter::from_query(query)?;
94:     let representation = representation_from_request(
95:         request,

518: fn temporal_history_from_entity(entity: &Value) -> Vec<TemporalAttributeRecord> {
519:     entity
520:         .as_object()
521:         .into_iter()
522:         .flat_map(|object| object.iter())
523:         .filter(|(key, _)| {
524:             !matches!(
525:                 key.as_str(),
526:                 "id" | "type" | "scope" | "@context" | "createdAt" | "modifiedAt" | "deletedAt"
527:             )
528:         })
529:         .map(|(attr_id, value)| record_from_value(attr_id, value))
530:         .collect()
531: }
532: 
533: fn record_from_value(attr_id: &str, value: &Value) -> TemporalAttributeRecord {
534:     let instance = make_temporal_instance(attr_id, value);
535:     TemporalAttributeRecord {
536:         attr_id: attr_id.to_string(),
537:         instance_id: instance
538:             .get("instanceId")
539:             .and_then(Value::as_str)
540:             .unwrap_or_default()
541:             .to_string(),
542:         observed_at: instance
543:             .get("observedAt")
544:             .and_then(Value::as_str)
545:             .map(ToString::to_string),
546:         created_at: instance
547:             .get("createdAt")
548:             .and_then(Value::as_str)
549:             .map(ToString::to_string),
550:         modified_at: instance
551:             .get("modifiedAt")
552:             .and_then(Value::as_str)
553:             .map(ToString::to_string),
554:         deleted_at: instance
555:             .get("deletedAt")
556:             .and_then(Value::as_str)
557:             .map(ToString::to_string),
558:         value: instance
559:             .get("value")
560:             .cloned()
561:             .unwrap_or_else(|| value.clone()),
562:     }
563: }
564: 
565: fn select_temporal_history(
566:     history: &[TemporalAttributeRecord],
567:     temporal: &TemporalFilter,
568: ) -> Vec<Value> {
569:     let mut selected = history
570:         .iter()
571:         .filter(|record| temporal_matches(record, temporal))
572:         .cloned()
573:         .collect::<Vec<_>>();
574: 
575:     if let Some(last_n) = temporal.last_n {
576:         selected.sort_by(|left, right| {
577:             temporal_record_time(right, temporal).cmp(&temporal_record_time(left, temporal))
578:         });
579:         selected.truncate(last_n as usize);
580:     }
581: 
582:     selected.into_iter().map(record_to_value).collect()
583: }
584: 
585: fn format_temporal_history(
586:     history: &[Value],
587:     representation: Representation,
588:     temporal: &TemporalFilter,
589: ) -> Vec<Value> {
590:     match representation {
591:         Representation::AggregatedValues => aggregate_temporal_history(history, temporal),
592:         Representation::TemporalValues
593:         | Representation::Normalized
594:         | Representation::KeyValues
595:         | Representation::GeoJson => history.to_vec(),
596:     }
597: }
598: 
599: fn aggregate_temporal_history(history: &[Value], temporal: &TemporalFilter) -> Vec<Value> {
600:     let mut grouped: std::collections::BTreeMap<String, Vec<f64>> =
601:         std::collections::BTreeMap::new();
602:     for item in history {
603:         let Some(attr_id) = item.get("attrId").and_then(Value::as_str) else {
604:             continue;
605:         };
606:         let number = item
607:             .get("value")
608:             .and_then(Value::as_object)
609:             .and_then(|value| value.get("value"))
610:             .and_then(Value::as_f64);
611:         if let Some(number) = number {
612:             grouped.entry(attr_id.to_string()).or_default().push(number);
613:         }
614:     }
615: 
616:     grouped
617:         .into_iter()
618:         .map(|(attr_id, values)| {
619:             let mut object = Map::new();
620:             object.insert("attrId".to_string(), Value::String(attr_id));
621:             object.insert(
622:                 "aggrMethods".to_string(),
623:                 Value::Array(
624:                     temporal
625:                         .aggr_methods
626:                         .iter()
627:                         .cloned()
628:                         .map(Value::String)
629:                         .collect(),
630:                 ),
631:             );
632: 
633:             let mut metrics = Map::new();
634:             for method in &temporal.aggr_methods {
635:                 let value = match method.as_str() {
636:                     "sum" => values.iter().sum::<f64>(),
637:                     "avg" => values.iter().sum::<f64>() / values.len().max(1) as f64,
638:                     "min" => values.iter().cloned().fold(f64::INFINITY, f64::min),
639:                     "max" => values.iter().cloned().fold(f64::NEG_INFINITY, f64::max),
640:                     "totalCount" | "distinctCount" => values.len() as f64,
641:                     _ => values.iter().sum::<f64>(),
642:                 };
643:                 metrics.insert(
644:                     method.clone(),
645:                     serde_json::Number::from_f64(value)
646:                         .map(Value::Number)
647:                         .unwrap_or(Value::Null),
648:                 );
649:             }
650:             object.insert("aggregated".to_string(), Value::Object(metrics));
651:             Value::Object(object)
652:         })
653:         .collect()
654: }
655: 
656: fn temporal_matches(record: &TemporalAttributeRecord, temporal: &TemporalFilter) -> bool {
657:     let Some(reference) = temporal_record_time(record, temporal) else {
658:         return false;
659:     };
660:     let lower = chrono::DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(&temporal.time_at).ok();
661:     let upper = temporal
662:         .end_time_at
663:         .as_deref()
664:         .and_then(|value| chrono::DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(value).ok());
665: 
666:     match temporal.time_rel.as_str() {
667:         "before" => lower.map(|lower| reference < lower).unwrap_or(false),
668:         "after" => lower.map(|lower| reference > lower).unwrap_or(false),
669:         "between" => lower
670:             .zip(upper)
671:             .map(|(lower, upper)| reference >= lower && reference <= upper)
672:             .unwrap_or(false),
673:         _ => false,
674:     }
675: }
676: 
677: fn temporal_record_time(
678:     record: &TemporalAttributeRecord,
679:     temporal: &TemporalFilter,
680: ) -> Option<chrono::DateTime<chrono::FixedOffset>> {
681:     let value = match temporal.time_property.as_str() {
682:         "createdAt" => record.created_at.as_deref(),
683:         "modifiedAt" => record.modified_at.as_deref(),
684:         "deletedAt" => record.deleted_at.as_deref(),
685:         _ => record
686:             .observed_at
687:             .as_deref()
688:             .or(record.created_at.as_deref()),
689:     }?;
690:     chrono::DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(value).ok()
691: }
692: 
693: fn record_to_value(record: TemporalAttributeRecord) -> Value {
694:     serde_json::json!({
695:         "attrId": record.attr_id,
696:         "instanceId": record.instance_id,
697:         "observedAt": record.observed_at,
698:         "createdAt": record.created_at,
699:         "modifiedAt": record.modified_at,
700:         "deletedAt": record.deleted_at,
701:         "value": record.value,
702:     })
703: }
704: 
705: fn temporal_snapshot(document: &TemporalEntityDocument) -> Value {
706:     let mut snapshot = document.doc.clone();
707:     if let Some(object) = snapshot.as_object_mut() {
708:         object.insert(
709:             "__swarmHistory".to_string(),
710:             Value::Array(
711:                 document
712:                     .history
713:                     .iter()
714:                     .filter_map(|record| serde_json::to_value(record).ok())
715:                     .collect(),
716:             ),
717:         );
718:     }
719:     snapshot
720: }

738:     }

741: async fn temporal_query_linked_graph(
742:     state: &AppState,
743:     context: &RequestContext,
744:     query: &TemporalEntityQuery,
745:     documents: &[TemporalEntityDocument],
746: ) -> Result<Arc<HashMap<String, Value>>, BrokerError> {
747:     if !query_needs_linked_graph(&query.entity) {
748:         return Ok(Arc::default());
749:     }
750: 
751:     let mut linked_entities = state
752:         .repositories
753:         .temporals
754:         .query(
755:             &context.tenant,
756:             &MongoQueryPlan::default(),
757:             &TemporalFilter::from_query(query)?,
758:             None,
759:         )
760:         .await?
761:         .into_iter()
762:         .map(|document| document.doc)
763:         .filter_map(|entity| {
764:             let id = entity.get("id").and_then(Value::as_str)?.to_string();
765:             Some((id, entity))
766:         })
767:         .collect::<HashMap<_, _>>();
768: 
769:     for document in documents {
770:         if let Some(id) = document.doc.get("id").and_then(Value::as_str) {
771:             linked_entities
772:                 .entry(id.to_string())
773:                 .or_insert_with(|| document.doc.clone());
774:         }
775:     }
776: 
777:     Ok(Arc::new(linked_entities))
778: }

120:     let entities = discovery_entities(state, request, context, local_only).await?;
121:     let accumulator = build_discovery(&entities);
122:     let aggregate = accumulator
123:         .by_attribute
124:         .get(attribute_name)
125:         .cloned()
126:         .ok_or_else(|| {
127:             BrokerError::NotFound(format!("attribute {attribute_name} was not found"))
128:         })?;
129: 
130:     Ok(serde_json::to_value(attribute_info(attribute_name.to_string(), aggregate)).unwrap())
131: }
132: 
133: async fn discovery_entities(
134:     state: &AppState,
135:     _request: &HttpRequest,
136:     context: &RequestContext,
137:     _local_only: bool,
138: ) -> Result<Vec<Value>, BrokerError> {
139:     let plan = MongoQueryPlan::default();
140:     let items = state
141:         .repositories
142:         .entities
143:         .query(&context.tenant, &plan)
144:         .await?;
145: 
146:     Ok(dedupe(items.into_iter().map(|item| item.doc).collect()))
147: }
148: 
149: fn build_discovery(entities: &[Value]) -> DiscoveryAccumulator {
150:     let mut accumulator = DiscoveryAccumulator::default();
151: 
152:     for entity in entities {
153:         let Some(type_name) = entity_primary_type(entity) else {
154:             continue;
155:         };
156: 
157:         let type_entry = accumulator.by_type.entry(type_name.clone()).or_default();
158:         type_entry.count += 1;
159: 
160:         for attr_name in entity_attribute_names(entity) {
161:             let attr_types = attribute_type_names(entity.get(&attr_name));
162: 
163:             let global_attr = accumulator
164:                 .by_attribute
165:                 .entry(attr_name.clone())
166:                 .or_default();
167:             global_attr.count += 1;
168:             global_attr.type_names.insert(type_name.clone());
169:             global_attr
170:                 .attribute_types
171:                 .extend(attr_types.iter().cloned());
172: 
173:             let type_attr = type_entry.attributes.entry(attr_name).or_default();
174:             type_attr.count += 1;
175:             type_attr.type_names.insert(type_name.clone());
176:             type_attr.attribute_types.extend(attr_types);
177:         }
178:     }
179: 
180:     accumulator
181: }
182: 
183: fn attribute_type_names(value: Option<&Value>) -> BTreeSet<String> {
184:     fn collect(value: &Value, into: &mut BTreeSet<String>) {
185:         match value {
186:             Value::Object(object) => {
187:                 if let Some(type_name) = object.get("type").and_then(Value::as_str) {
188:                     into.insert(type_name.to_string());
189:                 }
190:             }
191:             Value::Array(items) => {
192:                 for item in items {
193:                     collect(item, into);
194:                 }
195:             }
196:             _ => {}
197:         }
198:     }
199: 
200:     let mut types = BTreeSet::new();
201:     if let Some(value) = value {
202:         collect(value, &mut types);
203:     }
204:     if types.is_empty() {
205:         types.insert("Property".to_string());
206:     }
207:     types
208: }
209: 
210: fn type_info(type_name: String, aggregate: TypeAggregate) -> EntityTypeInfo {
211:     EntityTypeInfo {
212:         id: type_name.clone(),
213:         r#type: "EntityTypeInfo".to_string(),
214:         type_name,
215:         entity_count: aggregate.count,
216:         attribute_details: aggregate
217:             .attributes
218:             .into_iter()
219:             .map(|(attribute_name, details)| attribute_info(attribute_name, details))
220:             .collect(),
221:     }
222: }
223: 
224: fn attribute_info(attribute_name: String, aggregate: AttributeAggregate) -> AttributeInfo {
225:     AttributeInfo {
226:         id: attribute_name.clone(),
227:         r#type: "Attribute".to_string(),
228:         attribute_name,
229:         attribute_count: aggregate.count,
230:         attribute_types: aggregate.attribute_types.into_iter().collect(),
231:         type_names: aggregate.type_names.into_iter().collect(),
232:     }
233: }
234: 
235: fn dedupe(items: Vec<Value>) -> Vec<Value> {
236:     let mut seen = BTreeSet::new();
237:     let mut deduped = Vec::new();
238:     for item in items {
239:         let id = item
240:             .get("id")
241:             .and_then(Value::as_str)
242:             .unwrap_or_default()
243:             .to_string();
244:         if seen.insert(id) {
245:             deduped.push(item);
246:         }
247:     }
248:     deduped
249: }

178: async fn subscription_match_options(
179:     state: &AppState,
180:     subscription: &Value,
181:     entity: &Value,
182:     linked_entities: Arc<HashMap<String, Value>>,
183: ) -> Result<crate::query::language::QueryMatchOptions, BrokerError> {
184:     let context_terms = resolve_context_terms(
185:         &state.http_client,
186:         subscription
187:             .get("jsonldContext")
188:             .or_else(|| subscription.get("@context"))
189:             .or_else(|| entity.get("@context")),
190:         None,
191:     )
192:     .await?;
193:     Ok(QueryMatchOptions {
194:         expand_values: option_field_values(subscription, "expandValues")
195:             .into_iter()
196:             .collect(),
197:         json_keys: option_field_values(subscription, "jsonKeys")
198:             .into_iter()
199:             .collect(),
200:         context_terms,
201:         linked_entities,
202:     })
203: }

205: async fn entity_graph(
206:     tenant: &str,
207:     state: &AppState,
208:     entity: &Value,
209: ) -> Result<Vec<(String, Value)>, BrokerError> {
210:     let mut entities = state
211:         .repositories
212:         .entities
213:         .query(tenant, &crate::query::planner::MongoQueryPlan::default())
214:         .await?
215:         .into_iter()
216:         .map(|document| document.doc)
217:         .filter_map(|candidate| {
218:             let id = candidate.get("id").and_then(Value::as_str)?.to_string();
219:             Some((id, candidate))
220:         })
221:         .collect::<Vec<_>>();
222: 
223:     if let Some(id) = entity.get("id").and_then(Value::as_str)
224:         && !entities.iter().any(|(candidate_id, _)| candidate_id == id)
225:     {
226:         entities.push((id.to_string(), entity.clone()));
227:     }
228: 
229:     Ok(entities)
230: }

232: fn subscription_uses_linked_graph(subscription: &Value) -> bool {
233:     subscription
234:         .get("q")
235:         .and_then(Value::as_str)
236:         .and_then(|raw| parse_q_expression(Some(raw)).ok().flatten())
237:         .as_ref()
238:         .is_some_and(q_expression_uses_linked_entity)
239: }

241: fn option_field_values(document: &Value, field: &str) -> Vec<String> {
242:     match document.get(field) {
243:         Some(Value::String(value)) => crate::utils::json::parse_csv(Some(value)),
244:         Some(Value::Array(items)) => items
245:             .iter()
246:             .filter_map(Value::as_str)
247:             .map(ToString::to_string)
248:             .collect(),
249:         _ => Vec::new(),
250:     }
251: }

713: fn merge_peer_documents(existing: PeerDocument, incoming: PeerDocument) -> PeerDocument {
714:     let use_incoming_state = incoming_membership_is_newer(&existing, &incoming);
715:     PeerDocument {
716:         tenant: existing.tenant,
717:         peer_id: existing.peer_id,
718:         endpoint: incoming.endpoint,
719:         aliases: merge_strings(existing.aliases, incoming.aliases),
720:         capabilities: merge_strings(existing.capabilities, incoming.capabilities),
721:         neighbors: merge_strings(existing.neighbors, incoming.neighbors),
722:         status: if use_incoming_state {
723:             incoming.status
724:         } else {
725:             existing.status
726:         },
727:         incarnation: if use_incoming_state {
728:             incoming.incarnation
729:         } else {
730:             existing.incarnation
731:         },
732:         updated_at: if use_incoming_state {
733:             incoming.updated_at
734:         } else {
735:             existing.updated_at
736:         },
737:         last_synced_at: existing.last_synced_at,
738:         last_synced_at_nanos: existing.last_synced_at_nanos,
739:         last_mutation_cursor_nanos: existing.last_mutation_cursor_nanos,
740:     }
741: }
742: 
743: fn incoming_membership_is_newer(existing: &PeerDocument, incoming: &PeerDocument) -> bool {
744:     incoming.incarnation > existing.incarnation
745:         || (incoming.incarnation == existing.incarnation
746:             && status_rank(incoming.status) > status_rank(existing.status))
747:         || (incoming.incarnation == existing.incarnation
748:             && incoming.status == existing.status
749:             && timestamp_to_nanos(&incoming.updated_at).unwrap_or_default()
750:                 >= timestamp_to_nanos(&existing.updated_at).unwrap_or_default())
751: }
752: 
753: fn merge_strings(mut left: Vec<String>, right: Vec<String>) -> Vec<String> {
754:     for item in right {
755:         if !item.is_empty() && !left.iter().any(|existing| existing == &item) {
756:             left.push(item);
757:         }
758:     }
759:     left
760: }

762: fn status_rank(status: PeerStatus) -> u8 {
763:     match status {
764:         PeerStatus::Alive => 1,
765:         PeerStatus::Suspect => 2,
766:         PeerStatus::Dead => 3,
767:     }
768: }

770: fn mutation_is_newer(current: Option<&Value>, candidate: &str) -> bool {
771:     let current = current.and_then(Value::as_str).and_then(timestamp_to_nanos);
772:     let candidate = timestamp_to_nanos(candidate);
773:     match (current, candidate) {
774:         (_, None) => true,
775:         (None, Some(_)) => true,
776:         (Some(current), Some(candidate)) => candidate >= current,
777:     }
778: }

75: impl RedisEventQueue {
76:     pub fn new(redis_url: &str, stream: &str) -> Result<Self, QueueError> {
77:         Ok(Self {
78:             client: redis::Client::open(redis_url)?,
79:             stream: stream.to_string(),
80:         })
81:     }
82: 
83:     pub async fn start_worker(
84:         &self,
85:         repositories: MongoRepositories,
86:         config: AppConfig,
87:     ) -> Result<(), QueueError> {
88:         self.ensure_consumer_group(&config.redis_consumer_group)
89:             .await?;
90:         let queue = self.clone();
91: 
92:         tokio::spawn(async move {
93:             queue.worker_loop(repositories, config).await;
94:         });
95: 
96:         Ok(())
97:     }

99:     async fn ensure_consumer_group(&self, group: &str) -> Result<(), QueueError> {
100:         let mut connection = self.client.get_multiplexed_async_connection().await?;
101:         let result = redis::cmd("XGROUP")
102:             .arg("CREATE")
103:             .arg(&self.stream)
104:             .arg(group)
105:             .arg("0")
106:             .arg("MKSTREAM")
107:             .query_async::<String>(&mut connection)
108:             .await;
109: 
110:         match result {
111:             Ok(_) => Ok(()),
112:             Err(error) if error.code() == Some("BUSYGROUP") => Ok(()),
113:             Err(error) => Err(error.into()),
114:         }
115:     }
116: 
117:     async fn worker_loop(&self, repositories: MongoRepositories, config: AppConfig) {
118:         let http_client = match Client::builder()
119:             .timeout(Duration::from_millis(config.outbound_timeout_ms))
120:             .build()
121:         {
122:             Ok(client) => client,
123:             Err(error) => {
124:                 error!("failed to create outbound client for worker: {error}");
125:                 return;
126:             }
127:         };
128: 
129:         loop {
130:             match self
131:                 .read_pending_messages(&config.redis_consumer_group, &config.redis_consumer_name)
132:                 .await
133:             {
134:                 Ok(messages) => {
135:                     for (message_id, message) in messages {
136:                         if let Err(error) =
137:                             process_queue_message(&http_client, &repositories, &config, &message)
138:                                 .await
139:                         {
140:                             warn!("failed to process queue message {message_id}: {error}");
141:                         }
142: 
143:                         if let Err(error) =
144:                             self.ack(&config.redis_consumer_group, &message_id).await
145:                         {
146:                             warn!("failed to ACK queue message {message_id}: {error}");
147:                         }
148:                     }
149:                 }
150:                 Err(error) => {
151:                     error!("worker failed reading Redis stream: {error}");
152:                     sleep(Duration::from_secs(1)).await;
153:                 }
154:             }
155:         }
156:     }
157: 
158:     async fn read_pending_messages(
159:         &self,
160:         group: &str,
161:         consumer: &str,
162:     ) -> Result<Vec<(String, QueueMessage)>, QueueError> {
163:         let mut connection = self.client.get_multiplexed_async_connection().await?;
164:         let reply = redis::cmd("XREADGROUP")
165:             .arg("GROUP")
166:             .arg(group)
167:             .arg(consumer)
168:             .arg("COUNT")
169:             .arg(16)
170:             .arg("BLOCK")
171:             .arg(5000)
172:             .arg("STREAMS")
173:             .arg(&self.stream)
174:             .arg(">")
175:             .query_async::<StreamReadReply>(&mut connection)
176:             .await?;
177: 
178:         let mut messages = Vec::new();
179: 
180:         for stream_key in reply.keys {
181:             for stream_id in stream_key.ids {
182:                 if let Some(payload) = stream_id.map.get("payload") {
183:                     let payload: String = redis::from_redis_value(payload)?;
184:                     messages.push((stream_id.id, serde_json::from_str(&payload)?));
185:                 }
186:             }
187:         }
188: 
189:         Ok(messages)
190:     }
191: 
192:     async fn ack(&self, group: &str, message_id: &str) -> Result<(), QueueError> {
193:         let mut connection = self.client.get_multiplexed_async_connection().await?;
194:         let _ = redis::cmd("XACK")
195:             .arg(&self.stream)
196:             .arg(group)
197:             .arg(message_id)
198:             .query_async::<i64>(&mut connection)
199:             .await?;
200: 
201:         Ok(())
202:     }
203: }
204: 
205: #[async_trait]
206: impl EventQueue for RedisEventQueue {
207:     async fn enqueue(&self, message: QueueMessage) -> Result<(), QueueError> {
208:         let payload = serde_json::to_string(&message)?;
209:         let mut connection = self.client.get_multiplexed_async_connection().await?;
210: 
211:         let _ = redis::cmd("XADD")
212:             .arg(&self.stream)
213:             .arg("*")
214:             .arg("payload")
215:             .arg(payload)
216:             .query_async::<String>(&mut connection)
217:             .await?;
218: 
219:         Ok(())
220:     }
221: }
222: 
223: #[derive(Default)]
224: pub struct InMemoryEventQueue {
225:     messages: Mutex<Vec<QueueMessage>>,
226: }
227: 
228: impl InMemoryEventQueue {
229:     pub fn messages(&self) -> Vec<QueueMessage> {
230:         self.messages.lock().unwrap().clone()
231:     }
232: }
233: 
234: #[async_trait]
235: impl EventQueue for InMemoryEventQueue {
236:     async fn enqueue(&self, message: QueueMessage) -> Result<(), QueueError> {
237:         self.messages.lock().unwrap().push(message);
238:         Ok(())
239:     }
240: }

242: async fn process_queue_message(
243:     http_client: &Client,
244:     repositories: &MongoRepositories,
245:     _config: &AppConfig,
246:     message: &QueueMessage,
247: ) -> Result<(), QueueError> {
248:     match message {
249:         QueueMessage::Notification(job) => {
250:             let response = http_client
251:                 .post(&job.endpoint)
252:                 .json(&job.payload)
253:                 .send()
254:                 .await;
255:             let success = response
256:                 .as_ref()
257:                 .map(|resp| resp.status().is_success())
258:                 .unwrap_or(false);
259:             match job.target_kind {
260:                 NotificationTargetKind::Subscription => {
261:                     repositories
262:                         .subscriptions
263:                         .mark_delivery(&job.tenant, &job.subscription_id, success, &now_timestamp())
264:                         .await
265:                         .ok();
266:                 }
267:             }
268:             Ok(())
269:         }
270:         QueueMessage::Swim(job) => {
271:             let target_url = build_target_url(&job.endpoint, "/ngsi-ld/v1/internal/swim", None)?;
272:             let _ = http_client
273:                 .post(target_url)
274:                 .header(crate::context::headers::HEADER_TENANT, &job.tenant)
275:                 .json(&job.payload)
276:                 .send()
277:                 .await?;
278:             Ok(())
279:         }
280:     }
281: }
282: 
283: fn build_target_url(endpoint: &str, path: &str, query: Option<&str>) -> Result<String, QueueError> {
284:     let endpoint = if endpoint.ends_with('/') {
285:         endpoint.to_string()
286:     } else {
287:         format!("{endpoint}/")
288:     };
289: 
290:     let base_url = Url::parse(&endpoint)
291:         .map_err(|error| QueueError::Other(format!("invalid endpoint {endpoint}: {error}")))?;
292:     let relative_path = if base_url
293:         .path()
294:         .trim_end_matches('/')
295:         .ends_with(crate::services::common::BASE_PATH)
296:     {
297:         path.strip_prefix(crate::services::common::BASE_PATH)
298:             .unwrap_or(path)
299:             .trim_start_matches('/')
300:     } else {
301:         path.trim_start_matches('/')
302:     };
303: 
304:     let mut url = base_url
305:         .join(relative_path)
306:         .map_err(|error| QueueError::Other(format!("invalid path {path}: {error}")))?;
307: 
308:     if let Some(query_string) = query {
309:         url.set_query(Some(query_string));
310:     }
311: 
312:     Ok(url.to_string())
313: }
