132: pub fn q_expression_matches_value_with_options(
133:     expression: &QExpression,
134:     value: &Value,
135:     options: &QueryMatchOptions,
136: ) -> bool {
137:     match expression {
138:         QExpression::Exists(attribute) => {
139:             !resolve_query_attribute(value, attribute, options).is_empty()
140:         }
141:         QExpression::Eq(attribute, operand) => resolve_query_attribute(value, attribute, options)
142:             .iter()
143:             .any(|candidate| equality_matches(candidate, attribute, operand, options)),
144:         QExpression::Neq(attribute, operand) => {
145:             let candidates = resolve_query_attribute(value, attribute, options);
146:             !candidates.is_empty()
147:                 && candidates
148:                     .iter()
149:                     .all(|candidate| !equality_matches(candidate, attribute, operand, options))
150:         }
151:         QExpression::Gt(attribute, expected) => {
152:             compare_query_attribute(value, attribute, expected, options, |ordering| {
153:                 ordering == Ordering::Greater
154:             })
155:         }
156:         QExpression::Gte(attribute, expected) => {
157:             compare_query_attribute(value, attribute, expected, options, |ordering| {
158:                 matches!(ordering, Ordering::Greater | Ordering::Equal)
159:             })
160:         }
161:         QExpression::Lt(attribute, expected) => {
162:             compare_query_attribute(value, attribute, expected, options, |ordering| {
163:                 ordering == Ordering::Less
164:             })
165:         }
166:         QExpression::Lte(attribute, expected) => {
167:             compare_query_attribute(value, attribute, expected, options, |ordering| {
168:                 matches!(ordering, Ordering::Less | Ordering::Equal)
169:             })
170:         }
171:         QExpression::Pattern(attribute, pattern) => Regex::new(pattern).ok().is_some_and(|regex| {
172:             resolve_query_attribute(value, attribute, options)
173:                 .iter()
174:                 .any(|candidate| pattern_matches(candidate, attribute, &regex, options))
175:         }),
176:         QExpression::NotPattern(attribute, pattern) => {
177:             Regex::new(pattern).ok().is_some_and(|regex| {
178:                 let candidates = resolve_query_attribute(value, attribute, options);
179:                 !candidates.is_empty()
180:                     && candidates
181:                         .iter()
182:                         .all(|candidate| not_pattern_matches(candidate, attribute, &regex, options))
183:             })
184:         }
185:         QExpression::And(parts) => parts
186:             .iter()
187:             .all(|part| q_expression_matches_value_with_options(part, value, options)),
188:         QExpression::Or(parts) => parts
189:             .iter()
190:             .any(|part| q_expression_matches_value_with_options(part, value, options)),
191:     }
192: }
193: 
194: pub fn q_expression_uses_linked_entity(expression: &QExpression) -> bool {
195:     match expression {
196:         QExpression::Exists(attribute)
197:         | QExpression::Eq(attribute, _)
198:         | QExpression::Neq(attribute, _)
199:         | QExpression::Gt(attribute, _)
200:         | QExpression::Gte(attribute, _)
201:         | QExpression::Lt(attribute, _)
202:         | QExpression::Lte(attribute, _)
203:         | QExpression::Pattern(attribute, _)
204:         | QExpression::NotPattern(attribute, _) => attribute_uses_linked_entity(attribute),
205:         QExpression::And(parts) | QExpression::Or(parts) => {
206:             parts.iter().any(q_expression_uses_linked_entity)
207:         }
208:     }
209: }
210: 
211: pub fn parse_scope_expression(
212:     scope_q: Option<&str>,
213: ) -> Result<Option<ScopeExpression>, BrokerError> {
214:     let Some(scope_q) = scope_q else {
215:         return Ok(None);
216:     };
217:     let scope_q = scope_q.trim();
218:     if scope_q.is_empty() {
219:         return Ok(None);
220:     }
221: 
222:     parse_scope_or(scope_q).map(Some)
223: }
224: 
225: pub fn scope_query_matches_values(
226:     scopes: &[String],
227:     scope_q: Option<&str>,
228: ) -> Result<bool, BrokerError> {
229:     let Some(expression) = parse_scope_expression(scope_q)? else {
230:         return Ok(true);
231:     };
232: 
233:     Ok(scope_expression_matches_values(&expression, scopes))
234: }
235: 
236: pub fn scope_expression_matches_values(expression: &ScopeExpression, scopes: &[String]) -> bool {
237:     match expression {
238:         ScopeExpression::AnyNonEmpty => scopes.iter().any(|scope| !scope.trim().is_empty()),
239:         ScopeExpression::Pattern(pattern) => scopes
240:             .iter()
241:             .any(|scope| scope_pattern_matches(scope, pattern)),
242:         ScopeExpression::And(patterns) => patterns.iter().all(|pattern| {
243:             scopes
244:                 .iter()
245:                 .any(|scope| scope_pattern_matches(scope, pattern))
246:         }),
247:         ScopeExpression::Or(parts) => parts
248:             .iter()
249:             .any(|part| scope_expression_matches_values(part, scopes)),
250:     }
251: }
252: 
253: pub fn extract_scope_values(value: &Value) -> Vec<String> {
254:     match value.get("scope") {
255:         Some(Value::String(scope)) => vec![scope.clone()],
256:         Some(Value::Array(scopes)) => scopes
257:             .iter()
258:             .filter_map(Value::as_str)
259:             .map(ToString::to_string)
260:             .collect(),
261:         _ => Vec::new(),
262:     }
263: }
264: 
265: fn parse_q_or(expression: &str) -> Result<QExpression, BrokerError> {
266:     let expression = strip_wrapping_parentheses(expression);
267:     let parts = split_top_level(expression, &['|']);
268:     if parts.len() > 1 {
269:         Ok(QExpression::Or(
270:             parts
271:                 .into_iter()
272:                 .map(parse_q_and)
273:                 .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>()?,
274:         ))
275:     } else {
276:         parse_q_and(expression)
277:     }
278: }
279: 
280: fn parse_q_and(expression: &str) -> Result<QExpression, BrokerError> {
281:     let expression = strip_wrapping_parentheses(expression);
282:     let parts = split_top_level(expression, &[';']);
283:     if parts.len() > 1 {
284:         Ok(QExpression::And(
285:             parts
286:                 .into_iter()
287:                 .map(parse_q_term)
288:                 .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>()?,
289:         ))
290:     } else {
291:         parse_q_term(expression)
292:     }
293: }
294: 
295: fn parse_q_term(term: &str) -> Result<QExpression, BrokerError> {
296:     let term = term.trim();
297:     if is_wrapped_by_parentheses(term) {
298:         return parse_q_or(&term[1..term.len() - 1]);
299:     }
300:     let Some((index, operator)) = find_top_level_operator(term) else {
301:         return Ok(QExpression::Exists(parse_query_attribute(term)?));
302:     };
303: 
304:     let attribute = parse_query_attribute(term[..index].trim())?;
305:     let right = term[index + operator.len()..].trim();
306:     if right.is_empty() {
307:         return Err(BrokerError::BadRequest(format!(
308:             "missing right-hand side in q expression term: {term}"
309:         )));
310:     }
311: 
312:     match operator {
313:         "==" => Ok(QExpression::Eq(attribute, parse_equality_operand(right)?)),
314:         "!=" => Ok(QExpression::Neq(attribute, parse_equality_operand(right)?)),
315:         ">" => Ok(QExpression::Gt(attribute, parse_comparable_value(right)?)),
316:         ">=" => Ok(QExpression::Gte(attribute, parse_comparable_value(right)?)),
317:         "<" => Ok(QExpression::Lt(attribute, parse_comparable_value(right)?)),
318:         "<=" => Ok(QExpression::Lte(attribute, parse_comparable_value(right)?)),
319:         "~=" => Ok(QExpression::Pattern(attribute, parse_regex_pattern(right)?)),
320:         "!~=" => Ok(QExpression::NotPattern(
321:             attribute,
322:             parse_regex_pattern(right)?,
323:         )),
324:         _ => Err(BrokerError::BadRequest(format!(
325:             "invalid q expression term: {term}"
326:         ))),
327:     }
328: }
329: 
330: fn parse_query_attribute(raw: &str) -> Result<QueryAttribute, BrokerError> {
331:     let raw = raw.trim();
332:     if raw.is_empty() {
333:         return Err(BrokerError::BadRequest(
334:             "empty q attribute path".to_string(),
335:         ));
336:     }
337: 
338:     if let Some(open) = find_top_level_char(raw, '{') {
339:         let relation = raw[..open].trim();
340:         validate_name(relation, "query relation")?;
341:         let Some(close) = find_matching_delimiter(raw, open, '{', '}') else {
342:             return Err(BrokerError::BadRequest(format!(
343:                 "invalid linked entity path {raw}"
344:             )));
345:         };
346:         if close + 1 != raw.len() {
347:             return Err(BrokerError::BadRequest(format!(
348:                 "invalid linked entity path {raw}"
349:             )));
350:         }
351: 
352:         let (entity_types, attribute) = parse_linked_entity_path(&raw[open + 1..close])?;
353:         return Ok(QueryAttribute::LinkedEntity {
354:             relation: relation.to_string(),
355:             entity_types,
356:             attribute: Box::new(attribute),
357:         });
358:     }
359: 
360:     parse_value_path(raw)
361: }
362: 
363: fn parse_linked_entity_path(raw: &str) -> Result<(Vec<String>, QueryAttribute), BrokerError> {
364:     if let Some(index) = find_top_level_char(raw, ':') {
365:         let entity_types = raw[..index]
366:             .split(',')
367:             .map(str::trim)
368:             .filter(|value| !value.is_empty())
369:             .map(|value| {
370:                 validate_name(value, "query entity type")?;
371:                 Ok(value.to_string())
372:             })
373:             .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, BrokerError>>()?;
374:         if entity_types.is_empty() {
375:             return Err(BrokerError::BadRequest(format!(
376:                 "invalid linked entity path {raw}"
377:             )));
378:         }
379:         Ok((
380:             entity_types,
381:             parse_query_attribute(raw[index + 1..].trim())?,
382:         ))
383:     } else {
384:         Ok((Vec::new(), parse_query_attribute(raw.trim())?))
385:     }
386: }
387: 
388: fn parse_value_path(raw: &str) -> Result<QueryAttribute, BrokerError> {
389:     let (base, trailing_path) = if let Some(start) = find_top_level_char(raw, '[') {
390:         let Some(end) = find_matching_delimiter(raw, start, '[', ']') else {
391:             return Err(BrokerError::BadRequest(format!(
392:                 "invalid query attribute path {raw}"
393:             )));
394:         };
395:         if end + 1 != raw.len() {
396:             return Err(BrokerError::BadRequest(format!(
397:                 "invalid query attribute path {raw}"
398:             )));
399:         }
400:         if find_top_level_char(&raw[end + 1..], '[').is_some() {
401:             return Err(BrokerError::BadRequest(format!(
402:                 "invalid query attribute path {raw}"
403:             )));
404:         }
405: 
406:         let trailing = raw[start + 1..end].trim();
407:         let trailing_path = if trailing == "*" {
408:             Some(TrailingPath::AnyLanguage)
409:         } else {
410:             Some(TrailingPath::Members(parse_dotted_names(
411:                 trailing,
412:                 "query trailing path",
413:             )?))
414:         };
415:         (&raw[..start], trailing_path)
416:     } else {
417:         (raw, None)
418:     };
419: 
420:     Ok(QueryAttribute::ValuePath {
421:         segments: parse_dotted_names(base.trim(), "query attribute")?,
422:         trailing_path,
423:     })
424: }
425: 
426: fn parse_dotted_names(raw: &str, label: &str) -> Result<Vec<String>, BrokerError> {
427:     let names = raw
428:         .split('.')
429:         .map(str::trim)
430:         .filter(|segment| !segment.is_empty())
431:         .map(|segment| {
432:             validate_name(segment, label)?;
433:             Ok(segment.to_string())
434:         })
435:         .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, BrokerError>>()?;
436:     if names.is_empty() {
437:         Err(BrokerError::BadRequest(format!(
438:             "invalid {label} path {raw}"
439:         )))
440:     } else {
441:         Ok(names)
442:     }
443: }
444: 
445: fn parse_query_value(raw: &str) -> Result<Value, BrokerError> {
446:     if raw.starts_with('"') || raw.starts_with('[') || raw.starts_with('{') {
447:         serde_json::from_str(raw)
448:             .map_err(|error| BrokerError::BadRequest(format!("invalid q literal {raw}: {error}")))
449:     } else if raw.eq_ignore_ascii_case("true") || raw.eq_ignore_ascii_case("false") {
450:         Ok(Value::Bool(raw.eq_ignore_ascii_case("true")))
451:     } else if let Ok(number) = raw.parse::<f64>() {
452:         Ok(serde_json::Number::from_f64(number)
453:             .map(Value::Number)
454:             .unwrap_or_else(|| Value::String(raw.to_string())))
455:     } else {
456:         Ok(Value::String(raw.to_string()))
457:     }
458: }
459: 
460: fn parse_comparable_value(raw: &str) -> Result<Value, BrokerError> {
461:     let value = parse_query_value(raw)?;
462:     match value {
463:         Value::Number(_) | Value::String(_) => Ok(value),
464:         _ => Err(BrokerError::BadRequest(format!(
465:             "invalid comparable q literal {raw}"
466:         ))),
467:     }
468: }
469: 
470: fn parse_equality_operand(raw: &str) -> Result<EqualityOperand, BrokerError> {
471:     if let Some((lower, upper)) = split_once_top_level(raw, "..") {
472:         return Ok(EqualityOperand::Range(
473:             parse_comparable_value(lower.trim())?,
474:             parse_comparable_value(upper.trim())?,
475:         ));
476:     }
477: 
478:     let values = split_top_level(raw, &[',']);
479:     if values.len() > 1 {
480:         return Ok(EqualityOperand::List(
481:             values
482:                 .into_iter()
483:                 .map(|value| parse_query_value(value.trim()))
484:                 .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>()?,
485:         ));
486:     }
487: 
488:     Ok(EqualityOperand::Single(parse_query_value(raw.trim())?))
489: }
490: 
491: fn parse_regex_pattern(raw: &str) -> Result<String, BrokerError> {
492:     let pattern = if raw.starts_with('"') {
493:         serde_json::from_str::<String>(raw)
494:             .map_err(|error| BrokerError::BadRequest(format!("invalid q regex {raw}: {error}")))?
495:     } else {
496:         raw.to_string()
497:     };
498: 
499:     Regex::new(&pattern)
500:         .map_err(|error| BrokerError::BadRequest(format!("invalid q regex {pattern}: {error}")))?;
501:     Ok(pattern)
502: }
503: 
504: fn parse_scope_or(expression: &str) -> Result<ScopeExpression, BrokerError> {
505:     let expression = expression.trim();
506:     let parts = split_top_level(expression, &['|', ',']);
507:     if parts.len() > 1 {
508:         Ok(ScopeExpression::Or(
509:             parts
510:                 .into_iter()
511:                 .map(parse_scope_branch)
512:                 .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>()?,
513:         ))
514:     } else {
515:         parse_scope_branch(expression)
516:     }
517: }
518: 
519: fn parse_scope_branch(expression: &str) -> Result<ScopeExpression, BrokerError> {
520:     let expression = expression.trim();
521:     if expression == "/#" {
522:         return Ok(ScopeExpression::AnyNonEmpty);
523:     }
524: 
525:     if is_wrapped_by_parentheses(expression) {
526:         let inner = &expression[1..expression.len() - 1];
527:         let patterns = split_top_level(inner, &[';'])
528:             .into_iter()
529:             .map(parse_scope_pattern)
530:             .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>()?;
531:         if patterns.len() == 1 {
532:             Ok(ScopeExpression::Pattern(
533:                 patterns.into_iter().next().unwrap(),
534:             ))
535:         } else {
536:             Ok(ScopeExpression::And(patterns))
537:         }
538:     } else {
539:         if split_top_level(expression, &[';']).len() > 1 {
540:             return Err(BrokerError::BadRequest(
541:                 "scopeQ conjunctions require parentheses".to_string(),
542:             ));
543:         }
544:         Ok(ScopeExpression::Pattern(parse_scope_pattern(expression)?))
545:     }
546: }
547: 
548: fn parse_scope_pattern(raw: &str) -> Result<ScopePattern, BrokerError> {
549:     if raw == "/#" {
550:         return Ok(ScopePattern {
551:             levels: Vec::new(),
552:             include_descendants: true,
553:         });
554:     }
555: 
556:     let (raw, include_descendants) = if let Some(raw) = raw.strip_suffix("/#") {
557:         (raw, true)
558:     } else {
559:         (raw, false)
560:     };
561: 
562:     if !raw.starts_with('/') {
563:         return Err(BrokerError::BadRequest(format!(
564:             "invalid scopeQ scope {raw}"
565:         )));
566:     }
567: 
568:     let levels = raw
569:         .split('/')
570:         .skip(1)
571:         .map(str::trim)
572:         .filter(|level| !level.is_empty())
573:         .map(|level| {
574:             if level == "+" {
575:                 Ok(ScopeLevel::SingleLevelWildcard)
576:             } else {
577:                 validate_name(level, "scope")?;
578:                 Ok(ScopeLevel::Exact(level.to_string()))
579:             }
580:         })
581:         .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, BrokerError>>()?;
582: 
583:     if levels.is_empty() {
584:         return Err(BrokerError::BadRequest(format!(
585:             "invalid scopeQ scope {raw}"
586:         )));
587:     }
588: 
589:     Ok(ScopePattern {
590:         levels,
591:         include_descendants,
592:     })
593: }
594: 
595: fn validate_name(value: &str, label: &str) -> Result<(), BrokerError> {
596:     let mut chars = value.chars();
597:     let Some(first) = chars.next() else {
598:         return Err(BrokerError::BadRequest(format!("invalid {label} name")));
599:     };
600:     if !first.is_alphabetic() {
601:         return Err(BrokerError::BadRequest(format!(
602:             "invalid {label} name {value}"
603:         )));
604:     }
605:     if chars.all(|ch| ch.is_alphanumeric() || ch == '_') {
606:         Ok(())
607:     } else {
608:         Err(BrokerError::BadRequest(format!(
609:             "invalid {label} name {value}"
610:         )))
611:     }
612: }
613: 
614: fn resolve_query_attribute<'a>(
615:     root: &'a Value,
616:     attribute: &QueryAttribute,
617:     options: &'a QueryMatchOptions,
618: ) -> Vec<&'a Value> {
619:     match attribute {
620:         QueryAttribute::ValuePath { segments, .. } => resolve_path_nodes(root, segments)
621:             .into_iter()
622:             .flat_map(expand_attribute_instances)
623:             .collect(),
624:         QueryAttribute::LinkedEntity {
625:             relation,
626:             entity_types,
627:             attribute,
628:         } => resolve_path_nodes(root, std::slice::from_ref(relation))
629:             .into_iter()
630:             .flat_map(expand_attribute_instances)
631:             .filter(|candidate| relationship_like(attribute_kind(candidate)))
632:             .flat_map(|candidate| linked_entity_targets(candidate, entity_types, options))
633:             .flat_map(|linked| resolve_query_attribute(linked, attribute, options))
634:             .collect(),
635:     }
636: }
637: 
638: fn resolve_path_nodes<'a>(root: &'a Value, segments: &[String]) -> Vec<&'a Value> {
639:     segments.iter().fold(vec![root], |current, segment| {
640:         current
641:             .into_iter()
642:             .flat_map(|candidate| match candidate {
643:                 Value::Object(object) => object.get(segment).into_iter().collect::<Vec<_>>(),
644:                 Value::Array(items) => items
645:                     .iter()
646:                     .filter_map(|item| item.as_object().and_then(|object| object.get(segment)))
647:                     .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
648:                 _ => Vec::new(),
649:             })
650:             .collect()
651:     })
652: }
653: 
654: fn expand_attribute_instances(value: &Value) -> Vec<&Value> {
655:     match value {
656:         Value::Array(items)
657:             if items
658:                 .iter()
659:                 .all(|item| item.is_object() && item.get("type").is_some()) =>
660:         {
661:             items.iter().collect()
662:         }
663:         _ => vec![value],
664:     }
665: }
666: 
667: fn linked_entity_targets<'a>(
668:     relationship: &'a Value,
669:     entity_types: &[String],
670:     options: &'a QueryMatchOptions,
671: ) -> Vec<&'a Value> {
672:     let Some(object) = relationship.as_object() else {
673:         return Vec::new();
674:     };
675: 
676:     let targets = match object.get("object") {
677:         Some(Value::Object(_)) => object.get("object").into_iter().collect::<Vec<_>>(),
678:         Some(Value::String(id)) => options
679:             .linked_entities
680:             .get(id)
681:             .into_iter()
682:             .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
683:         Some(Value::Array(items)) => items
684:             .iter()
685:             .flat_map(|item| match item {
686:                 Value::Object(_) => Some(item),
687:                 Value::String(id) => options.linked_entities.get(id),
688:                 _ => None,
689:             })
690:             .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
691:         _ => Vec::new(),
692:     };
693: 
694:     targets
695:         .into_iter()
696:         .filter(|target| {
697:             entity_types.is_empty()
698:                 || entity_type_matches(target.get("type"), object.get("objectType"), entity_types)
699:         })
700:         .collect()
701: }
702: 
703: fn entity_type_matches(
704:     inline_type: Option<&Value>,
705:     object_type: Option<&Value>,
706:     expected_types: &[String],
707: ) -> bool {
708:     expected_types.iter().any(|expected| {
709:         value_matches_string(inline_type, expected) || value_matches_string(object_type, expected)
710:     })
711: }
712: 
713: fn value_matches_string(value: Option<&Value>, expected: &str) -> bool {
714:     match value {
715:         Some(Value::String(actual)) => actual == expected,
716:         Some(Value::Array(items)) => items.iter().any(|item| item.as_str() == Some(expected)),
717:         _ => false,
718:     }
719: }
720: 
721: fn equality_matches(
722:     candidate: &Value,
723:     attribute: &QueryAttribute,
724:     operand: &EqualityOperand,
725:     options: &QueryMatchOptions,
726: ) -> bool {
727:     match operand {
728:         EqualityOperand::Single(expected) => {
729:             let expected = coerce_expected_value(attribute, expected, options);
730:             target_values(candidate, attribute, options)
731:                 .iter()
732:                 .any(|target| eq_value(target, &expected))
733:         }
734:         EqualityOperand::List(expected) => {
735:             let expected = expected
736:                 .iter()
737:                 .map(|value| coerce_expected_value(attribute, value, options))
738:                 .collect::<Vec<_>>();
739:             target_values(candidate, attribute, options)
740:                 .iter()
741:                 .any(|target| expected.iter().any(|expected| eq_value(target, expected)))
742:         }
743:         EqualityOperand::Range(lower, upper) => {
744:             let lower = coerce_expected_value(attribute, lower, options);
745:             let upper = coerce_expected_value(attribute, upper, options);
746:             target_values(candidate, attribute, options)
747:                 .iter()
748:                 .any(|target| range_contains(target, &lower, &upper))
749:         }
750:     }
751: }
752: 
753: fn compare_query_attribute<F>(
754:     root: &Value,
755:     attribute: &QueryAttribute,
756:     expected: &Value,
757:     options: &QueryMatchOptions,
758:     predicate: F,
759: ) -> bool
760: where
761:     F: Fn(Ordering) -> bool,
762: {
763:     let expected = coerce_expected_value(attribute, expected, options);
764:     resolve_query_attribute(root, attribute, options)
765:         .iter()
766:         .any(|candidate| {
767:             let kind = attribute_kind(candidate);
768:             if relationship_like(kind) {
769:                 return false;
770:             }
771: 
772:             flattened_values(target_values(candidate, attribute, options))
773:                 .into_iter()
774:                 .filter_map(|target| compare_query_values(&target, &expected))
775:                 .any(&predicate)
776:         })
777: }
778: 
779: fn pattern_matches(
780:     candidate: &Value,
781:     attribute: &QueryAttribute,
782:     regex: &Regex,
783:     options: &QueryMatchOptions,
784: ) -> bool {
785:     target_values(candidate, attribute, options)
786:         .iter()
787:         .any(|target| match target {
788:             Value::String(text) => regex.is_match(text),
789:             Value::Array(items) => items
790:                 .iter()
791:                 .filter_map(Value::as_str)
792:                 .any(|text| regex.is_match(text)),
793:             _ => false,
794:         })
795: }
796: 
797: fn not_pattern_matches(
798:     candidate: &Value,
799:     attribute: &QueryAttribute,
800:     regex: &Regex,
801:     options: &QueryMatchOptions,
802: ) -> bool {
803:     let targets = target_values(candidate, attribute, options);
804:     !targets.is_empty()
805:         && targets.iter().all(|target| match target {
806:             Value::String(text) => !regex.is_match(text),
807:             Value::Array(items) if items.iter().all(Value::is_string) => items
808:                 .iter()
809:                 .filter_map(Value::as_str)
810:                 .all(|text| !regex.is_match(text)),
811:             _ => false,
812:         })
813: }
814: 
815: fn target_values(
816:     candidate: &Value,
817:     attribute: &QueryAttribute,
818:     options: &QueryMatchOptions,
819: ) -> Vec<Value> {
820:     let trailing_path = attribute.trailing_path();
821:     match trailing_path {
822:         Some(trailing_path) => {
823:             target_values_with_trailing(candidate, attribute, trailing_path, options)
824:         }
825:         None => target_values_without_trailing(candidate, attribute, options),
826:     }
827: }
828: 
829: fn target_values_without_trailing(
830:     candidate: &Value,
831:     attribute: &QueryAttribute,
832:     options: &QueryMatchOptions,
833: ) -> Vec<Value> {
834:     match attribute_kind(candidate) {
835:         AttributeKind::Raw => vec![candidate.clone()],
836:         AttributeKind::Property | AttributeKind::GeoProperty => {
837:             coerce_property_values(candidate, attribute, options)
838:         }
839:         AttributeKind::Relationship | AttributeKind::ListRelationship => {
840:             candidate.get("object").cloned().into_iter().collect()
841:         }
842:         AttributeKind::LanguageProperty => language_map_values(candidate.get("languageMap")),
843:         AttributeKind::VocabProperty => coerce_vocab_values(candidate, attribute, options),
844:         AttributeKind::ListProperty => candidate.get("valueList").cloned().into_iter().collect(),
845:         AttributeKind::JsonProperty => coerce_json_values(candidate, attribute, options),
846:     }
847: }
848: 
849: fn target_values_with_trailing(
850:     candidate: &Value,
851:     attribute: &QueryAttribute,
852:     trailing_path: &TrailingPath,
853:     options: &QueryMatchOptions,
854: ) -> Vec<Value> {
855:     match (attribute_kind(candidate), trailing_path) {
856:         (AttributeKind::LanguageProperty, TrailingPath::AnyLanguage) => {
857:             language_map_values(candidate.get("languageMap"))
858:         }
859:         (AttributeKind::LanguageProperty, TrailingPath::Members(path)) => {
860:             let Some(language_map) = candidate.get("languageMap").and_then(Value::as_object) else {
861:                 return Vec::new();
862:             };
863:             let Some((language, rest)) = path.split_first() else {
864:                 return Vec::new();
865:             };
866:             let seeds = if language == "*" {
867:                 language_map.values().collect::<Vec<_>>()
868:             } else {
869:                 language_map.get(language).into_iter().collect::<Vec<_>>()
870:             };
871: 
872:             if rest.is_empty() {
873:                 seeds.into_iter().flat_map(flatten_language_value).collect()
874:             } else {
875:                 seeds
876:                     .into_iter()
877:                     .flat_map(|seed| traverse_member_path(seed, rest))
878:                     .collect()
879:             }
880:         }
881:         (_, TrailingPath::AnyLanguage) => Vec::new(),
882:         (kind, TrailingPath::Members(path)) => {
883:             seed_target_values(candidate, kind, attribute, options)
884:                 .into_iter()
885:                 .flat_map(|seed| traverse_member_path(&seed, path))
886:                 .collect()
887:         }
888:     }
889: }
890: 
891: fn seed_target_values(
892:     candidate: &Value,
893:     kind: AttributeKind,
894:     attribute: &QueryAttribute,
895:     options: &QueryMatchOptions,
896: ) -> Vec<Value> {
897:     match kind {
898:         AttributeKind::Raw => vec![candidate.clone()],
899:         AttributeKind::Property | AttributeKind::GeoProperty => {
900:             coerce_property_values(candidate, attribute, options)
901:         }
902:         AttributeKind::Relationship | AttributeKind::ListRelationship => {
903:             candidate.get("object").cloned().into_iter().collect()
904:         }
905:         AttributeKind::LanguageProperty => {
906:             candidate.get("languageMap").cloned().into_iter().collect()
907:         }
908:         AttributeKind::VocabProperty => coerce_vocab_values(candidate, attribute, options),
909:         AttributeKind::ListProperty => candidate.get("valueList").cloned().into_iter().collect(),
910:         AttributeKind::JsonProperty => coerce_json_values(candidate, attribute, options),
911:     }
912: }
913: 
914: fn coerce_property_values(
915:     candidate: &Value,
916:     attribute: &QueryAttribute,
917:     options: &QueryMatchOptions,
918: ) -> Vec<Value> {
919:     let Some(attr_name) = attribute.root_name() else {
920:         return candidate.get("value").cloned().into_iter().collect();
921:     };
922: 
923:     if options.json_keys.contains(attr_name) {
924:         if let Some(json) = candidate.get("json").cloned() {
925:             return vec![json];
926:         }
927:     }
928: 
929:     if options.expand_values.contains(attr_name)
930:         && let Some(value) = candidate.get("value")
931:     {
932:         return vec![expand_compacted_value(value, &options.context_terms)];
933:     }
934: 
935:     candidate.get("value").cloned().into_iter().collect()
936: }
937: 
938: fn coerce_vocab_values(
939:     candidate: &Value,
940:     attribute: &QueryAttribute,
941:     options: &QueryMatchOptions,
942: ) -> Vec<Value> {
943:     let Some(vocab) = candidate.get("vocab") else {
944:         return Vec::new();
945:     };
946:     let Some(attr_name) = attribute.root_name() else {
947:         return vec![vocab.clone()];
948:     };
949: 
950:     if options.expand_values.contains(attr_name) {
951:         return vec![expand_compacted_value(vocab, &options.context_terms)];
952:     }
953: 
954:     vec![vocab.clone()]
955: }
956: 
957: fn coerce_json_values(
958:     candidate: &Value,
959:     attribute: &QueryAttribute,
960:     options: &QueryMatchOptions,
961: ) -> Vec<Value> {
962:     let Some(attr_name) = attribute.root_name() else {
963:         return candidate.get("json").cloned().into_iter().collect();
964:     };
965: 
966:     if options.json_keys.contains(attr_name) {
967:         candidate.get("json").cloned().into_iter().collect()
968:     } else {
969:         candidate
970:             .get("value")
971:             .or_else(|| candidate.get("json"))
972:             .cloned()
973:             .into_iter()
974:             .collect()
975:     }
976: }
977: 
978: fn coerce_expected_value(
979:     attribute: &QueryAttribute,
980:     value: &Value,
981:     options: &QueryMatchOptions,
982: ) -> Value {
983:     let Some(attr_name) = attribute.root_name() else {
984:         return value.clone();
985:     };
986: 
987:     if options.json_keys.contains(attr_name) {
988:         return value.clone();
989:     }
990: 
991:     if options.expand_values.contains(attr_name) {
992:         return expand_compacted_value(value, &options.context_terms);
993:     }
994: 
995:     value.clone()
996: }
997: 
998: fn expand_compacted_value(value: &Value, context_terms: &HashMap<String, String>) -> Value {
999:     match value {
1000:         Value::String(text) => context_terms
1001:             .get(text)
1002:             .cloned()
1003:             .map(Value::String)
1004:             .unwrap_or_else(|| value.clone()),
1005:         Value::Array(items) => Value::Array(
1006:             items
1007:                 .iter()
1008:                 .map(|item| expand_compacted_value(item, context_terms))
1009:                 .collect(),
1010:         ),
1011:         _ => value.clone(),
1012:     }
1013: }
1014: 
1015: fn traverse_member_path(root: &Value, path: &[String]) -> Vec<Value> {
1016:     path.iter()
1017:         .fold(vec![root], |current, segment| {
1018:             current
1019:                 .into_iter()
1020:                 .flat_map(|candidate| match candidate {
1021:                     Value::Object(object) => object.get(segment).into_iter().collect::<Vec<_>>(),
1022:                     Value::Array(items) => items
1023:                         .iter()
1024:                         .filter_map(|item| item.as_object().and_then(|object| object.get(segment)))
1025:                         .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
1026:                     _ => Vec::new(),
1027:                 })
1028:                 .collect()
1029:         })
1030:         .into_iter()
1031:         .cloned()
1032:         .collect()
1033: }
1034: 
1035: fn language_map_values(language_map: Option<&Value>) -> Vec<Value> {
1036:     language_map
1037:         .and_then(Value::as_object)
1038:         .map(|entries| entries.values().flat_map(flatten_language_value).collect())
1039:         .unwrap_or_default()
1040: }
1041: 
1042: fn flatten_language_value(value: &Value) -> Vec<Value> {
1043:     match value {
1044:         Value::Array(items) => items.to_vec(),
1045:         _ => vec![value.clone()],
1046:     }
1047: }
1048: 
1049: fn flattened_values(values: Vec<Value>) -> Vec<Value> {
1050:     let mut flattened = Vec::new();
1051:     for value in values {
1052:         match value {
1053:             Value::Array(items) => flattened.extend(items),
1054:             _ => flattened.push(value),
1055:         }
1056:     }
1057:     flattened
1058: }

1060: #[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
1061: enum AttributeKind {
1062:     Raw,
1063:     Property,
1064:     GeoProperty,
1065:     Relationship,
1066:     ListRelationship,
1067:     LanguageProperty,
1068:     VocabProperty,
1069:     ListProperty,
1070:     JsonProperty,
1071: }
1072: 
1073: fn attribute_kind(value: &Value) -> AttributeKind {
1074:     match value.get("type").and_then(Value::as_str) {
1075:         Some("Property") => AttributeKind::Property,
1076:         Some("GeoProperty") => AttributeKind::GeoProperty,
1077:         Some("Relationship") => AttributeKind::Relationship,
1078:         Some("ListRelationship") => AttributeKind::ListRelationship,
1079:         Some("LanguageProperty") => AttributeKind::LanguageProperty,
1080:         Some("VocabProperty") => AttributeKind::VocabProperty,
1081:         Some("ListProperty") => AttributeKind::ListProperty,
1082:         Some("JsonProperty") => AttributeKind::JsonProperty,
1083:         _ => AttributeKind::Raw,
1084:     }
1085: }
1086: 
1087: fn relationship_like(kind: AttributeKind) -> bool {
1088:     matches!(
1089:         kind,
1090:         AttributeKind::Relationship | AttributeKind::ListRelationship
1091:     )
1092: }
1093: 
1094: fn eq_value(target: &Value, expected: &Value) -> bool {
1095:     values_equal(target, expected)
1096:         || matches!(target, Value::Array(items) if items.iter().any(|item| values_equal(item, expected)))
1097: }
1098: 
1099: fn range_contains(target: &Value, lower: &Value, upper: &Value) -> bool {
1100:     matches!(
1101:         compare_query_values(target, lower),
1102:         Some(Ordering::Greater | Ordering::Equal)
1103:     ) && matches!(
1104:         compare_query_values(target, upper),
1105:         Some(Ordering::Less | Ordering::Equal)
1106:     ) || matches!(target, Value::Array(items) if items.iter().any(|item| range_contains(item, lower, upper)))
1107: }
1108: 
1109: fn values_equal(left: &Value, right: &Value) -> bool {
1110:     match (left, right) {
1111:         (Value::Number(left), Value::Number(right)) => left.as_f64() == right.as_f64(),
1112:         (Value::String(left), Value::String(right)) => left == right,
1113:         (Value::Bool(left), Value::Bool(right)) => left == right,
1114:         (Value::Array(_), Value::Array(_)) | (Value::Object(_), Value::Object(_)) => left == right,
1115:         _ => false,
1116:     }
1117: }
1118: 
1119: #[derive(Clone, Copy)]
1120: enum ComparableScalar<'a> {
1121:     Number(f64),
1122:     Bool(bool),
1123:     DateTime(DateTime<FixedOffset>),
1124:     Date(NaiveDate),
1125:     Time(NaiveTime),
1126:     Text(&'a str),
1127: }
1128: 
1129: fn compare_query_values(left: &Value, right: &Value) -> Option<Ordering> {
1130:     let left = comparable_scalar(left)?;
1131:     let right = comparable_scalar(right)?;
1132:     match (left, right) {
1133:         (ComparableScalar::Number(left), ComparableScalar::Number(right)) => {
1134:             left.partial_cmp(&right)
1135:         }
1136:         (ComparableScalar::Bool(left), ComparableScalar::Bool(right)) => Some(left.cmp(&right)),
1137:         (ComparableScalar::DateTime(left), ComparableScalar::DateTime(right)) => {
1138:             Some(left.cmp(&right))
1139:         }
1140:         (ComparableScalar::Date(left), ComparableScalar::Date(right)) => Some(left.cmp(&right)),
1141:         (ComparableScalar::Time(left), ComparableScalar::Time(right)) => Some(left.cmp(&right)),
1142:         (ComparableScalar::Text(left), ComparableScalar::Text(right)) => Some(left.cmp(right)),
1143:         _ => None,
1144:     }
1145: }
1146: 
1147: fn comparable_scalar(value: &Value) -> Option<ComparableScalar<'_>> {
1148:     match value {
1149:         Value::Number(number) => number.as_f64().map(ComparableScalar::Number),
1150:         Value::Bool(flag) => Some(ComparableScalar::Bool(*flag)),
1151:         Value::String(text) => {
1152:             if let Ok(value) = DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(text) {
1153:                 Some(ComparableScalar::DateTime(value))
1154:             } else if let Ok(value) = NaiveDate::parse_from_str(text, "%Y-%m-%d") {
1155:                 Some(ComparableScalar::Date(value))
1156:             } else if let Ok(value) = NaiveTime::parse_from_str(text, "%H:%M:%S") {
1157:                 Some(ComparableScalar::Time(value))
1158:             } else if let Ok(value) = NaiveTime::parse_from_str(text, "%H:%M:%S%.f") {
1159:                 Some(ComparableScalar::Time(value))
1160:             } else {
1161:                 Some(ComparableScalar::Text(text))
1162:             }
1163:         }
1164:         _ => None,
1165:     }
1166: }
1167: 
1168: fn scope_pattern_matches(scope: &str, pattern: &ScopePattern) -> bool {
1169:     if pattern.levels.is_empty() {
1170:         return !scope.trim().is_empty();
1171:     }
1172: 
1173:     let levels = scope
1174:         .split('/')
1175:         .skip(1)
1176:         .filter(|level| !level.is_empty())
1177:         .collect::<Vec<_>>();
1178:     if levels.is_empty() {
1179:         return false;
1180:     }
1181: 
1182:     if pattern.include_descendants {
1183:         if levels.len() < pattern.levels.len() {
1184:             return false;
1185:         }
1186:     } else if levels.len() != pattern.levels.len() {
1187:         return false;
1188:     }
1189: 
1190:     pattern
1191:         .levels
1192:         .iter()
1193:         .zip(levels.iter())
1194:         .all(|(expected, actual)| match expected {
1195:             ScopeLevel::Exact(expected) => expected == actual,
1196:             ScopeLevel::SingleLevelWildcard => true,
1197:         })
1198: }
1199: 
1200: fn split_top_level<'a>(expression: &'a str, separators: &[char]) -> Vec<&'a str> {
1201:     let mut parts = Vec::new();
1202:     let mut start = 0;
1203:     let mut state = ScanState::default();
1204: 
1205:     for (index, ch) in expression.char_indices() {
1206:         if state.is_top_level() && separators.contains(&ch) {
1207:             parts.push(expression[start..index].trim());
1208:             start = index + ch.len_utf8();
1209:             continue;
1210:         }
1211:         state.step(ch);
1212:     }
1213: 
1214:     parts.push(expression[start..].trim());
1215:     parts
1216: }
1217: 
1218: fn split_once_top_level<'a>(expression: &'a str, needle: &str) -> Option<(&'a str, &'a str)> {
1219:     let mut state = ScanState::default();
1220:     for (index, ch) in expression.char_indices() {
1221:         if state.is_top_level() && expression[index..].starts_with(needle) {
1222:             return Some((&expression[..index], &expression[index + needle.len()..]));
1223:         }
1224:         state.step(ch);
1225:     }
1226:     None
1227: }
1228: 
1229: fn find_top_level_operator(expression: &str) -> Option<(usize, &'static str)> {
1230:     const OPERATORS: [&str; 8] = ["!~=", "~=", ">=", "<=", "!=", "==", ">", "<"];
1231:     let mut state = ScanState::default();
1232:     for (index, ch) in expression.char_indices() {
1233:         if state.is_top_level()
1234:             && let Some(operator) = OPERATORS
1235:                 .iter()
1236:                 .copied()
1237:                 .find(|operator| expression[index..].starts_with(operator))
1238:         {
1239:             return Some((index, operator));
1240:         }
1241:         state.step(ch);
1242:     }
1243:     None
1244: }
1245: 
1246: fn find_top_level_char(expression: &str, needle: char) -> Option<usize> {
1247:     let mut state = ScanState::default();
1248:     for (index, ch) in expression.char_indices() {
1249:         if state.is_top_level() && ch == needle {
1250:             return Some(index);
1251:         }
1252:         state.step(ch);
1253:     }
1254:     None
1255: }
1256: 
1257: fn find_matching_delimiter(
1258:     expression: &str,
1259:     open_index: usize,
1260:     open: char,
1261:     close: char,
1262: ) -> Option<usize> {
1263:     let mut depth = 0_i32;
1264:     let mut in_string = false;
1265:     let mut escaped = false;
1266:     for (index, ch) in expression[open_index..].char_indices() {
1267:         let absolute_index = open_index + index;
1268:         if in_string {
1269:             if escaped {
1270:                 escaped = false;
1271:             } else if ch == '\\' {
1272:                 escaped = true;
1273:             } else if ch == '"' {
1274:                 in_string = false;
1275:             }
1276:             continue;
1277:         }
1278: 
1279:         if ch == '"' {
1280:             in_string = true;
1281:             continue;
1282:         }
1283: 
1284:         if ch == open {
1285:             depth += 1;
1286:         } else if ch == close {
1287:             depth -= 1;
1288:             if depth == 0 {
1289:                 return Some(absolute_index);
1290:             }
1291:         }
1292:     }
1293:     None
1294: }
1295: 
1296: fn strip_wrapping_parentheses(expression: &str) -> &str {
1297:     let mut expression = expression.trim();
1298:     while is_wrapped_by_parentheses(expression) {
1299:         expression = expression[1..expression.len() - 1].trim();
1300:     }
1301:     expression
1302: }
1303: 
1304: fn is_wrapped_by_parentheses(expression: &str) -> bool {
1305:     if !expression.starts_with('(') || !expression.ends_with(')') {
1306:         return false;
1307:     }
1308: 
1309:     let mut state = ScanState::default();
1310:     for (index, ch) in expression.char_indices() {
1311:         state.step(ch);
1312:         if state.is_top_level() {
1313:             return index + ch.len_utf8() == expression.len();
1314:         }
1315:     }
1316: 
1317:     false
1318: }
1319: 
1320: #[derive(Default)]
1321: struct ScanState {
1322:     paren_depth: i32,
1323:     brace_depth: i32,
1324:     bracket_depth: i32,
1325:     in_string: bool,
1326:     escaped: bool,
1327: }
1328: 
1329: impl ScanState {
1330:     fn is_top_level(&self) -> bool {
1331:         !self.in_string && self.paren_depth == 0 && self.brace_depth == 0 && self.bracket_depth == 0
1332:     }
1333: 
1334:     fn step(&mut self, ch: char) {
1335:         if self.in_string {
1336:             if self.escaped {
1337:                 self.escaped = false;
1338:             } else if ch == '\\' {
1339:                 self.escaped = true;
1340:             } else if ch == '"' {
1341:                 self.in_string = false;
1342:             }
1343:             return;
1344:         }
1345: 
1346:         match ch {
1347:             '"' => self.in_string = true,
1348:             '(' => self.paren_depth += 1,
1349:             ')' => self.paren_depth -= 1,
1350:             '{' => self.brace_depth += 1,
1351:             '}' => self.brace_depth -= 1,
1352:             '[' => self.bracket_depth += 1,
1353:             ']' => self.bracket_depth -= 1,
1354:             _ => {}
1355:         }
1356:     }
1357: }
1358: 
1359: impl QueryAttribute {
1360:     fn trailing_path(&self) -> Option<&TrailingPath> {
1361:         match self {
1362:             QueryAttribute::ValuePath { trailing_path, .. } => trailing_path.as_ref(),
1363:             QueryAttribute::LinkedEntity { attribute, .. } => attribute.trailing_path(),
1364:         }
1365:     }
1366: 
1367:     fn root_name(&self) -> Option<&str> {
1368:         match self {
1369:             QueryAttribute::ValuePath { segments, .. } => segments.first().map(String::as_str),
1370:             QueryAttribute::LinkedEntity { attribute, .. } => attribute.root_name(),
1371:         }
1372:     }
1373: }
1374: 
1375: fn attribute_uses_linked_entity(attribute: &QueryAttribute) -> bool {
1376:     match attribute {
1377:         QueryAttribute::ValuePath { .. } => false,
1378:         QueryAttribute::LinkedEntity { .. } => true,
1379:     }
1380: }

44: impl MongoQueryPlan {
45:     pub fn from_entity_query(query: &EntityQuery) -> Result<Self, BrokerError> {
46:         let q_expression = parse_q_expression(query.q.as_deref())?;
47:         let _ = parse_scope_expression(query.scope_q.as_deref())?;

52:             id_pattern: query.id_pattern.clone(),

58:                 query.coordinates.as_deref(),
59:                 query.geoproperty.as_deref(),
60:             )?,
61:             limit: if query.q.is_some() || query.scope_q.is_some() {
62:                 None
63:             } else {
64:                 query.limit
65:             },
66:         })
67:     }

69:     pub fn to_bson_filter(&self, tenant: &str) -> Result<Document, BrokerError> {
70:         let mut clauses = vec![doc! {"tenant": tenant}];
71: 
72:         if !self.ids.is_empty() {
73:             clauses.push(doc! {"id": {"$in": self.ids.clone()}});
74:         }
75: 
76:         if !self.entity_types.is_empty() {
77:             if self.entity_types.len() == 1 {
78:                 clauses.push(doc! {
79:                     "$or": [
80:                         {"doc.type": &self.entity_types[0]},
81:                         {"doc.type": {"$elemMatch": {"$eq": &self.entity_types[0]}}}
82:                     ]
83:                 });
84:             } else {
85:                 clauses.push(doc! {
86:                     "$or": [
87:                         {"doc.type": {"$in": self.entity_types.clone()}},
88:                         {"doc.type": {"$elemMatch": {"$in": self.entity_types.clone()}}}
89:                     ]
90:                 });
91:             }
92:         }
93: 
94:         if let Some(id_pattern) = &self.id_pattern {
95:             let _ = Regex::new(id_pattern)
96:                 .map_err(|error| BrokerError::BadRequest(format!("invalid idPattern: {error}")))?;
97:             clauses.push(doc! {"id": {"$regex": id_pattern}});
98:         }
99: 
100:         for attr in &self.attrs {
101:             clauses.push(doc! {format!("doc.{attr}"): {"$exists": true}});
102:         }
103: 
104:         if let Some(geo) = &self.geo {
105:             clauses.push(geo.to_bson()?);
106:         }
107: 
108:         Ok(if clauses.len() == 1 {
109:             clauses.remove(0)
110:         } else {
111:             doc! {"$and": clauses}
112:         })
113:     }
114: }

116: impl GeoFilter {
117:     pub fn to_bson(&self) -> Result<Document, BrokerError> {
118:         let property = format!("doc.{}.value", self.geoproperty);
119:         let geo_json = match self.geometry.as_str() {
120:             "Point" | "MultiPoint" | "LineString" | "MultiLineString" | "Polygon"
121:             | "MultiPolygon" => {
122:                 json!({
123:                     "type": self.geometry,
124:                     "coordinates": self.coordinates,
125:                 })
126:             }
127:             other => {
128:                 return Err(BrokerError::BadRequest(format!(
129:                     "unsupported geometry {other}"
130:                 )));
131:             }
132:         };
133: 
134:         let geo_doc = bson::to_bson(&geo_json).map_err(|error| {
135:             BrokerError::BadRequest(format!("invalid geo coordinates: {error}"))
136:         })?;
137: 
138:         if self.georel.starts_with("near;") {
139:             let mut spec = doc! {"$geometry": geo_doc};
140:             for token in self.georel.split(';').skip(1) {
141:                 if let Some((distance_type, raw_value)) = token.split_once("==") {
142:                     let distance = raw_value.parse::<i64>().map_err(|error| {
143:                         BrokerError::BadRequest(format!(
144:                             "invalid near distance {raw_value}: {error}"
145:                         ))
146:                     })?;
147:                     match distance_type {
148:                         "maxDistance" => {
149:                             spec.insert("$maxDistance", distance);
150:                         }
151:                         "minDistance" => {
152:                             spec.insert("$minDistance", distance);
153:                         }
154:                         _ => {
155:                             return Err(BrokerError::BadRequest(format!(
156:                                 "invalid georel near clause {distance_type}"
157:                             )));
158:                         }
159:                     }
160:                 }
161:             }
162:             Ok(doc! {property: {"$near": spec}})
163:         } else {
164:             let operator = match self.georel.as_str() {
165:                 "within" => "$geoWithin",
166:                 "intersects" => "$geoIntersects",
167:                 "contains" => "$geoWithin",
168:                 "overlaps" => "$geoIntersects",
169:                 "equals" => "$geoIntersects",
170:                 "disjoint" => {
171:                     return Err(BrokerError::NotImplemented(
172:                         "georel disjoint is not supported by the Mongo query planner".to_string(),
173:                     ));
174:                 }
175:                 other => {
176:                     return Err(BrokerError::BadRequest(format!("invalid georel {other}")));
177:                 }
178:             };
179: 
180:             Ok(doc! {property: {operator: {"$geometry": geo_doc}}})
181:         }
182:     }
183: }

185: impl TemporalFilter {
186:     pub fn from_query(query: &TemporalEntityQuery) -> Result<Self, BrokerError> {
187:         let time_rel = query
188:             .time_rel
189:             .clone()
190:             .ok_or_else(|| BrokerError::BadRequest("timerel is required".to_string()))?;
191:         let time_at = query
192:             .time_at
193:             .clone()
194:             .ok_or_else(|| BrokerError::BadRequest("timeAt is required".to_string()))?;
195: 
196:         if time_rel == "between" && query.end_time_at.is_none() {
197:             return Err(BrokerError::BadRequest(
198:                 "endTimeAt is required when timerel=between".to_string(),
199:             ));
200:         }
201: 
202:         Ok(Self {
203:             time_property: query
204:                 .time_property
205:                 .clone()
206:                 .unwrap_or_else(|| "observedAt".to_string()),
207:             time_rel,
208:             time_at,
209:             end_time_at: query.end_time_at.clone(),
210:             last_n: query.last_n,
211:             aggr_methods: split_csv(query.aggr_methods.as_deref()),
212:             aggr_period_duration: query.aggr_period_duration.clone(),
213:             representation: temporal_representation(
214:                 query.entity.format.as_deref(),
215:                 query.entity.options.as_deref(),
216:             ),
217:         })
218:     }
219: }
220: 
221: pub fn parse_geo_filter(
222:     geometry: Option<&str>,
223:     georel: Option<&str>,
224:     coordinates: Option<&str>,
225:     geoproperty: Option<&str>,
226: ) -> Result<Option<GeoFilter>, BrokerError> {
227:     if geometry.is_none() && georel.is_none() && coordinates.is_none() {
228:         return Ok(None);
229:     }
230: 
231:     let geometry = geometry.ok_or_else(|| {
232:         BrokerError::BadRequest("geometry is required for geo queries".to_string())
233:     })?;
234:     let georel = georel
235:         .ok_or_else(|| BrokerError::BadRequest("georel is required for geo queries".to_string()))?;
236:     let coordinates = coordinates.ok_or_else(|| {
237:         BrokerError::BadRequest("coordinates is required for geo queries".to_string())
238:     })?;
239: 
240:     let coordinates: Value = serde_json::from_str(coordinates).map_err(|error| {
241:         BrokerError::BadRequest(format!(
242:             "coordinates must be valid JSON coordinates: {error}"
243:         ))
244:     })?;
245: 
246:     Ok(Some(GeoFilter {
247:         geometry: geometry.to_string(),
248:         georel: georel.to_string(),
249:         geoproperty: geoproperty.unwrap_or("location").to_string(),
250:         coordinates,
251:     }))
252: }
253: 
254: fn split_csv(value: Option<&str>) -> Vec<String> {
255:     value
256:         .map(|value| {
257:             value
258:                 .split(',')
259:                 .map(str::trim)
260:                 .filter(|item| !item.is_empty())
261:                 .map(ToString::to_string)
262:                 .collect()
263:         })
264:         .unwrap_or_default()
265: }
266: 
267: fn temporal_representation(format: Option<&str>, options: Option<&str>) -> Representation {
268:     if format == Some("aggregatedValues")
269:         || options
270:             .map(|value| value.contains("aggregatedValues"))
271:             .unwrap_or(false)
272:     {
273:         Representation::AggregatedValues
274:     } else if format == Some("temporalValues")
275:         || options
276:             .map(|value| value.contains("temporalValues"))
277:             .unwrap_or(false)
278:     {
279:         Representation::TemporalValues
280:     } else {
281:         Representation::Normalized
282:     }
283: }

334:     async fn mark_delivery(
335:         &self,
336:         tenant: &str,
337:         subscription_id: &str,
338:         success: bool,
339:         now: &str,
340:     ) -> Result<(), BrokerError> {
341:         let mut subscription = match self.get(tenant, subscription_id).await? {
342:             Some(subscription) => subscription,
343:             None => return Ok(()),
344:         };
345: 
346:         if let Some(notification) = subscription
347:             .doc
348:             .get_mut("notification")
349:             .and_then(Value::as_object_mut)
350:         {
351:             let sent = notification
352:                 .get("timesSent")
353:                 .and_then(Value::as_u64)
354:                 .unwrap_or(0)
355:                 + 1;
356:             notification.insert("timesSent".to_string(), Value::from(sent));
357:             notification.insert(
358:                 "status".to_string(),
359:                 Value::String(if success { "ok" } else { "failed" }.to_string()),
360:             );
361:             notification.insert(
362:                 "lastNotification".to_string(),
363:                 Value::String(now.to_string()),
364:             );
365: 
366:             if success {
367:                 notification.insert("lastSuccess".to_string(), Value::String(now.to_string()));
368:             } else {
369:                 let failed = notification
370:                     .get("timesFailed")
371:                     .and_then(Value::as_u64)
372:                     .unwrap_or(0)
373:                     + 1;
374:                 notification.insert("timesFailed".to_string(), Value::from(failed));
375:                 notification.insert("lastFailure".to_string(), Value::String(now.to_string()));
376:             }
377:         }
378: 
379:         update_status_field(
380:             &mut subscription.doc,
381:             "modifiedAt",
382:             Value::String(now.to_string()),
383:         );
384:         self.replace(subscription).await
385:     }
386: }

540: fn encode<T: serde::Serialize>(value: &T) -> Result<Document, BrokerError> {
541:     to_document(value)

544: 
545: fn decode<T: serde::de::DeserializeOwned>(value: Document) -> Result<T, BrokerError> {
546:     from_document(value)
547:         .map_err(|error| BrokerError::internal(format!("bson decoding error: {error}")))
548: }

550: fn mongo_error(error: mongodb::error::Error) -> BrokerError {

554: async fn collect_documents(
555:     mut cursor: mongodb::Cursor<Document>,
556: ) -> Result<Vec<Document>, BrokerError> {
557:     let mut items = Vec::new();
558:     while cursor.advance().await.map_err(mongo_error)? {
559:         items.push(cursor.deserialize_current().map_err(mongo_error)?);
560:     }

334:     async fn mark_delivery(
335:         &self,
336:         tenant: &str,
337:         subscription_id: &str,
338:         success: bool,
339:         now: &str,
340:     ) -> Result<(), BrokerError> {
341:         let mut subscription = match self.get(tenant, subscription_id).await? {
342:             Some(subscription) => subscription,
343:             None => return Ok(()),
344:         };
345: 
346:         if let Some(notification) = subscription
347:             .doc
348:             .get_mut("notification")
349:             .and_then(Value::as_object_mut)
350:         {
351:             let sent = notification
352:                 .get("timesSent")
353:                 .and_then(Value::as_u64)
354:                 .unwrap_or(0)
355:                 + 1;
356:             notification.insert("timesSent".to_string(), Value::from(sent));
357:             notification.insert(
358:                 "status".to_string(),
359:                 Value::String(if success { "ok" } else { "failed" }.to_string()),
360:             );
361:             notification.insert(
362:                 "lastNotification".to_string(),
363:                 Value::String(now.to_string()),
364:             );
365: 
366:             if success {
367:                 notification.insert("lastSuccess".to_string(), Value::String(now.to_string()));
368:             } else {
369:                 let failed = notification
370:                     .get("timesFailed")
371:                     .and_then(Value::as_u64)
372:                     .unwrap_or(0)
373:                     + 1;
374:                 notification.insert("timesFailed".to_string(), Value::from(failed));
375:                 notification.insert("lastFailure".to_string(), Value::String(now.to_string()));
376:             }
377:         }
378: 
379:         update_status_field(
380:             &mut subscription.doc,
381:             "modifiedAt",
382:             Value::String(now.to_string()),
383:         );
384:         self.replace(subscription).await
385:     }
386: }

110:             .arg("CREATE")
111:             .arg(&self.stream)
112:             .arg(group)
113:             .arg("0")
114:             .arg("MKSTREAM")
115:             .query_async::<String>(&mut connection)
116:             .await;
117: 
118:         match result {
119:             Ok(_) => Ok(()),
120:             Err(error) if error.code() == Some("BUSYGROUP") => Ok(()),
121:             Err(error) => Err(error.into()),
122:         }
123:     }
124: 
125:     /// Runs blocking worker loop over Redis stream messages.
126:     async fn worker_loop(&self, repositories: MongoRepositories, config: AppConfig) {
127:         let http_client = match Client::builder()
128:             .timeout(Duration::from_millis(config.outbound_timeout_ms))
129:             .build()
130:         {
131:             Ok(client) => client,
132:             Err(error) => {
133:                 error!("failed to create outbound client for worker: {error}");
134:                 return;
135:             }
136:         };
137: 
138:         loop {
139:             match self
140:                 .read_pending_messages(&config.redis_consumer_group, &config.redis_consumer_name)
141:                 .await
142:             {
143:                 Ok(messages) => {
144:                     for (message_id, message) in messages {
145:                         if let Err(error) =
146:                             process_queue_message(&http_client, &repositories, &config, &message)
147:                                 .await
148:                         {
149:                             warn!("failed to process queue message {message_id}: {error}");
150:                         }
151: 
152:                         if let Err(error) =
153:                             self.ack(&config.redis_consumer_group, &message_id).await
154:                         {
155:                             warn!("failed to ACK queue message {message_id}: {error}");
156:                         }
157:                     }
158:                 }
159:                 Err(error) => {
160:                     error!("worker failed reading Redis stream: {error}");
161:                     sleep(Duration::from_secs(1)).await;
162:                 }
163:             }
164:         }
165:     }
166: 
167:     /// Reads next batch of queued messages from Redis.
168:     async fn read_pending_messages(
169:         &self,
170:         group: &str,
171:         consumer: &str,
172:     ) -> Result<Vec<(String, QueueMessage)>, QueueError> {
173:         let mut connection = self.client.get_multiplexed_async_connection().await?;
174:         let reply = redis::cmd("XREADGROUP")
175:             .arg("GROUP")
176:             .arg(group)
177:             .arg(consumer)
178:             .arg("COUNT")
179:             .arg(16)
180:             .arg("BLOCK")
181:             .arg(5000)
182:             .arg("STREAMS")
183:             .arg(&self.stream)
184:             .arg(">")
185:             .query_async::<StreamReadReply>(&mut connection)
186:             .await?;
187: 
188:         let mut messages = Vec::new();
189: 
190:         for stream_key in reply.keys {
191:             for stream_id in stream_key.ids {
192:                 if let Some(payload) = stream_id.map.get("payload") {
193:                     let payload: String = redis::from_redis_value(payload)?;
194:                     messages.push((stream_id.id, serde_json::from_str(&payload)?));
195:                 }
196:             }
197:         }
198: 
199:         Ok(messages)
200:     }
201: 
202:     /// ACKs processed message in Redis stream.
203:     async fn ack(&self, group: &str, message_id: &str) -> Result<(), QueueError> {
204:         let mut connection = self.client.get_multiplexed_async_connection().await?;
205:         let _ = redis::cmd("XACK")
206:             .arg(&self.stream)
207:             .arg(group)
208:             .arg(message_id)
209:             .query_async::<i64>(&mut connection)
210:             .await?;
211: 
212:         Ok(())
213:     }
214: }

297: pub(crate) fn build_target_url(
298:     endpoint: &str,
299:     path: &str,
300:     query: Option<&str>,
301: ) -> Result<String, QueueError> {
302:     let endpoint = if endpoint.ends_with('/') {
303:         endpoint.to_string()
304:     } else {
305:         format!("{endpoint}/")
306:     };
307: 
308:     let base_url = Url::parse(&endpoint)
309:         .map_err(|error| QueueError::Other(format!("invalid endpoint {endpoint}: {error}")))?;
310:     let base_path = base_url.path().trim_end_matches('/');
311:     let uses_ngsi_base = base_path.ends_with(crate::services::common::BASE_PATH);
312:     let mut join_base = base_url.clone();
313:     let relative_path = if uses_ngsi_base {
314:         if path.starts_with(crate::services::common::BASE_PATH) {
315:             path.strip_prefix(crate::services::common::BASE_PATH)
316:                 .unwrap_or(path)
317:                 .trim_start_matches('/')
318:         } else {
319:             let prefix = base_path
320:                 .strip_suffix(crate::services::common::BASE_PATH)
321:                 .unwrap_or(base_path)
322:                 .trim_end_matches('/');
323:             join_base.set_path(&format!("{}/", prefix));
324:             join_base.set_query(None);
325:             path.trim_start_matches('/')
326:         }
327:     } else {
328:         path.trim_start_matches('/')
329:     };
330: 
331:     let mut url = join_base
332:         .join(relative_path)
333:         .map_err(|error| QueueError::Other(format!("invalid path {path}: {error}")))?;
334: 
335:     if let Some(query_string) = query {
336:         url.set_query(Some(query_string));
337:     }
338: 
339:     Ok(url.to_string())
